It utilizes DC rapid charging technology capable of delivering high power levels in the range of 120–240 KW for level 3 fast charging to establish the connection between EVs and a DC microgrid. To improve the dynamic performance of the V2G-G2V charging stations, fuzzy logic-based control and Proportional Integral (PI) control systems are one kind of soft computing used. The performance of two distinct control systems, i.e., Fuzzy Logic Control and proportional integral Control, is compared with respect to their charging speed in V2G and G2V modes. The simulation models are designed to analyze both V2G and G2V modes. This results in a reduction in total harmonic distortion (THD), which is produced by grid-injected current, making it a superb example of active power management. The use of fuzzy logic control exhibits a remarkable decrease in THD from 0.09% to 0.02%. These results provide evidence of the potential for both efficient and reliable operation of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Pneumonia Detection in Chest X-rays using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Pneumonia is a life-threatening condition which affects people of all ages but is mostly found in infants and older adults. It is caused by a variety of factors including bacteria, viruses and fungi and causes infections in one lung or both. The diagnosis of Pneumonia is usually facilitated using chest X-rays. This diagnosis becomes difficult in cases where access to expert radiologists or doctors to discover the disease is unavailable. Hence, using a system which makes use of powerful Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques in order to make the diagnosis of Pneumonia in chest X-rays easier is more feasible. This problem has seen tremendous advancements in recent times with the use of various Computer Vision and ML methodologies. In this work, we have showcased the use of multiple such methods in order to create a complete system based on the purpose of detecting Pneumonia in chest X-rays. The integral component of the system is a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model, trained on a pre-processed dataset of chest X-rays. CNN has become the most used Deep Learning algorithm for computer vision problems due to its strength of dealing with images.

articleTitle: Fault Detection Method Using Signal Processing Approaches to Design a Power System Network Control Method
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper formulated a Stockwell-Hilbert composite fault detection method (SHCFDM) using current features extracted by the use of Stockwell transform (ST) and Hilbert transform (HT). A Stockwell-Hilbert composite fault index (SHCFI) is formulated which is effective to detect the faults incident on the power system network which includes fault with phase and ground (FWPG), fault with two phases (FW2P), fault with two phases and ground (FW2PG), fault with three phases (FW3P) and fault with three phases and ground (FW3PG). Fault sorting is done using number of faulty phases and a Stockwell-Hilbert ground fault index (SHGFI) which is computed by processing the zero sequence current (ZSC) using the SHCFDM. SHGFI identifies the ground with a fault. Proposed SHCFDM performs better compared to Discrete Wavelet transform (DWT) derived fault detection method. Study is performed on a two terminal power system transmission line (PSTL) connected on two power system bus (PSB) using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Computer Vision assisted Deep Learning based Sitting Posture Suggestion System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative framework that employs camera-captured visual data to detect and suggest optimal sitting postures. The framework consists of two crucial components: a video capture object and an object detection system that incorporates Deep Learning to enhance efficiency and reliability. The camera initially captures the user’s posture image, which is then subjected to video processing to extract video metadata. Subsequently, the object is created by extracting the image from the video, and the object detection algorithm is applied to provide posture recommendations. The algorithm continually monitors posture correctness and provides suggestions to improve it as necessary, ultimately benefiting the user’s daily life and mitigating potential long-term problems. Additionally, the algorithm can be further developed to recognize posture patterns and suggest corrective exercises or techniques. Furthermore, the algorithm’s efficiency can be enhanced by optimizing landmark detection for more effective outcomes. This cutting-edge framework offers immense potential for improving posture and overall health, and its development can significantly enhance the quality of life for individuals.

articleTitle: Forensic Acoustic Applications of Siamese Neural Networks for determining Lineal Relationships between Normal and Spectrally Disguised Voices
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In forensic applications, it is sometimes required to determine whether two speech samples, one in normal voice and other in a disguised form, are from the same speaker. In this study a Deep Learning based Siamese Neural Network is trained for determining whether normal and electronically disguised versions have same lineage. The Siamese Neural Network model was trained on speech samples from the Ravdess database and their electronically disguised versions. The disguised samples were generated using various mathematical functions to change the spectral content in the Fourier domain. The trained Siamese Neural Network attained an accuracy of 94.58 on trained data and 94% on test data.

articleTitle: GUI Implementation of Logic Built in Self-Test[LBIST]
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: A structural test technique known as "built-in self-test," or BIST, involves adding logic to an IC so that it can periodically test its own functionality. Memory BIST and logic BIST are the two main varieties. Memory BIST, also known as MBIST, creates patterns in memory that are then read to record any flaws. Additionally, memory BIST has redundancy and repair capabilities. Every die in this technology has an extra circuit. When a circuit malfunctions, it is disconnected and replaced with a working one. To find known good memory stacks for 2.5D/3D devices, Memory BIST is also utilized. A pseudorandom pattern generator is used by Logic BIST, also known as LBIST, to generate input patterns that are fed into internal scan chains. A signature is created by compressing the outcomes. Next, to indicate whether or not all tests were successful, a Multi-Input Signature Register ascertains the signature’s accuracy. The majority of LBIST’s applications are in high reliability, safety-critical industries like automotives. But as this would taint operation, LBIST needs a very clear design with no uncertain states. This indicates that the insertion of LBIST is more complicated than scan and requires considerably stricter design and test requirements. Significant timing, space, and power overhead is also incurred by LBIST.

articleTitle: LoRa NET Base Station Monitoring System: Real-time insights using Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: With the rapid evolution of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, there is an increasing demand for efficient and scalable solutions for remote monitoring and control systems. This paper introduces a LoRa (Long Range) Network-based Base Station Monitoring System that leverages LoRa technology for efficient and scalable remote monitoring. Employing LoRa-enabled sensors and gateways, the system establishes a robust wireless network, enabling the real-time transmission of critical data from remote base stations to a centralized server. A dedicated mobile application provides users with intuitive access to real-time insights, allowing monitoring of key performance indicators, environmental conditions, and operational parameters. With demonstrated effectiveness in diverse applications such as agriculture, industrial automation, and smart cities, the LoRa NET Base Station Monitoring System offers a cost-effective and scalable solution for large-scale deployment, contributing to the advancement of IoT-based monitoring solutions.

articleTitle: Precision in Pixel Prediction: Video Interpolation through Polynomial Fitting
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative method for video interpolation, focusing on enhancing temporal continuity in low frame-rate videos. The approach combines the power of the Polynomial Regression / Gaussian elimination with polynomial fitting to predict pixel values in intermediate frames, drawing data from k previous and k upcoming frames. Commencing with the challenge of improving video smoothness, the methodology involves transforming pixel data into the function domain, enabling the creation of polynomial representations that capture temporal dynamics accurately. Findings from this research underscore the effectiveness of the proposed technique in achieving higher frame rates while maintaining video quality. This method holds promise for addressing real-world video processing challenges, such as compression artifacts and noise. In conclusion, this abstract encapsulates the core elements of the paper, including its central idea, research method, key findings, and implications. The approach outlined herein offers a valuable contribution to video interpolation, with potential applications in multimedia, digital content creation, and video enhancement.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of FinFET models based Ternary 1-bit Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The emergence of multivalue logics in the realm of digital electronics has been recognized as a significant achievement, offering remedies to the constraints imposed by binary logic. Ternary logic is regarded as a novel approach in the domain of multivalue logic. This article presents the design of a ternary 1-bit multiplier utilizing 18nm FinFET technology in Virtuoso tool offered by Cadence. The performance of the multiplier is then evaluated by comparing the results obtained using the SVT and HVT models of FinFET. The obtained simulation results demonstrate power consumption as 43.18 and 38.71μW, transient delay as 30.24 and 50.29 ns, and power delay product as 1305.76 and 1946.72 (x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> J) for the SVT and HVT FinFET models, respectively. The proposed architecture of 1-bit ternary multiplier demonstrates advantages in terms of energy efficiency in computing systems and signal processing systems that utilize ternary signals.

articleTitle: FashionAI: Image-Based Clothing Detection and Shopping Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In today’s world, the retail fashion industry is going through radical transformations in terms of technology. The magnitude of options available on the internet makes it difficult to find suitable clothing items on online retail stores in an effective manner. To overcome this, we aimed to create a project that detects specific items of clothing from an image and makes real-time recommendations. We have developed a system which uses computer vision techniques to analyze images and recognize different types of clothing such as shirts, pants, dresses, etc. The system will then use machine learning algorithms to make product recommendations based on the similarity between the image uploaded by the user and products available on various e-commerce websites.

articleTitle: Network Inference Using Deep Reinforcement Learning for Early Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Community Inference the use of Deep Reinforcement mastering for early sickness Detection is an effective approach for predicting disorder onset early based totally on community dynamics. This technique applies a unique set of algorithms for education deep reinforcement gaining knowledge of fashions. The fashions are educated to locate early disease onset from the community shape and dynamics through reading complicated relationships between nodes inside the network. The fashions assemble a couple of synthetic agents which engage with the nodes inside the community and acquire capabilities based totally on connectivity and hobby. Primarily based on accumulated features, the version classifies the nodes as either wholesome or diseased to construct a sickness-specific chance profile. Similarly, the reinforcement mastering approach is implemented to enhance the performance of the version by way of supplying rewards while the version chooses appropriate movements for the duration of the education. In conclusion, community Inference using Deep Reinforcement mastering for early sickness Detection is an effective tool for predicting and stopping sickness earlier than it becomes enormous. This approach allows sickness professionals to become aware of key individuals in a community and alert them to scientific help, as a consequence preventing the disorder from spreading and growing the chances of survival for the ones affected.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Miniaturized Wi-Fi Logo Shaped Microstrip Patch Antenna for Ka-Band Application
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The novel miniaturized Wi-Fi logo slotted microstrip antenna application for 28 GHz is presented in this paper. The operating frequency is 28GHz-Ka-band application. The antenna is modeled by using substrate material of Rogers RT/Duroid 5880 with the relative permittivity value ԑ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>=2.2. The proposed antenna design has return loss parameters S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf><-10dB. The proposed design works in the frequency range: 28GHz. The radiation pattern is unidirectional and good gain is obtained. Slot configuration enhances the bandwidth of the antenna. It has a multiband response. The proposed design is simulated using HFSS (High-Frequency Simulation Software) simulator. It is a compact antenna with a size of 7x7mm a thickness of 0.8mm, a wide operational band, and good gain. The performance of the antennas in terms of return loss, bandwidth, efficiency, gain, and directivity are analyzed.

articleTitle: Recognition of Data Breach Method from Story Using Advanced Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: We often open our eyes in the morning with the appalling news of data breaches of different popular companies. This is a significant threat not only to giant companies but also to the general people’s privacy. Various methods are maneuvered for data breaches, and identifying these methods in a short can help understand the loss and take proper steps against these incidents. Researchers nowadays focus on the data breaches issue to reduce its threats to the tech industry. In this research, we have used advanced deep learning methods(e.g., BERT, XLNet, and Electra) to predict data breach methods using the data breach story. The proposed classifier has provided an accuracy of 92.86%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Construction Site Safety: A Tripartite Analysis of Safety Violations
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Construction sites encounter diverse safety challenges, from detecting safety gear compliance to identifying walking path hazards and preventing crane load falls. Navigating these safety concerns manually poses significant challenges for site administrators. In response, our project introduces an innovative approach employing modern detection methods suitable for the pertaining use cases. Through a unified system addressing safety gear detection, walking path hazard identification, and crane load fall prevention, our methodology significantly enhances on-site safety. By integrating the latest computer vision technologies, we achieved an effective detection rate, mitigating potential hazards and emphasizing a proactive safety approach. Our findings underscore the transformative potential of this system in revolutionizing construction site safety practices, reducing risks, and ensuring a secure working environment.

articleTitle: Robust Implementation of Security for Analog Circuits to Prevent Malfunction
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This article discusses the evolving nature of supply chain attacks, which have now shifted their focus towards targeting analog circuits because of their vulnerability to reverse engineering. The attackers' objective is to gain control over the circuit by understanding specific features or parameters, particularly the bias current of an operational amplifier and a ring oscillator. To address this security concern and prevent malfunctions, the article proposes a solution called "logic locking." This method involves integrating an encryption block with LFSR (Linear Feedback Shift Register) and a resistor switch to safeguard the operational amplifier and ring oscillator. By utilizing the encryption block's 8-bit output code and the resistor values, the relevant bias current values can be derived, thereby enabling secure and reliable circuit functioning.

articleTitle: Efficiency Improvement of Deepening Data Application of State Grid Power under Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In the process of deepening the data processing of State Grid Power, a machine learning algorithm is proposed to solve the problem that the data efficiency of State Grid Power cannot be effectively improved. Using mechanical learning theory to classify the power data of State Grid and find mining strategies for all kinds of data; Then, under the guidance of machine learning theory, we find the best data efficiency improvement strategy. The results show that the machine learning algorithm can improve the accuracy of data processing and shorten the time of data deepening.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Band Selection Strategies for Improved Classification of Hyper Spectral Data
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This study explores the overall performance of diverse band selection strategies in improving the accuracy of classifications of hyperspectral facts. The use of various characteristic selection algorithms examined inside an aid Vector system; the paper seeks to examine the strategies and their blended overall performance in information on the complex relationships between the numerous spectral signatures. The paper additionally explores two hybrid band choice techniques, which combine unique forms of feature selection techniques collectively to compare accuracy profits below exceptional feature selection parameters. Effects from the vast experiments advise that there's clear potential to improve classification performance by using band selection to hyperspectral facts. The proposed hybrid strategies are observed to showcase excellent performance in the assessment, presenting a promising technique for destiny programs. Hyperspectral facts classification results can be stepped forward by selecting the foremost set of spectral bands for the challenge. It is to maximize the accuracy of the supervised hyperspectral records class. Strategies tested include selecting a subset of bands using either an iterative look-beforehand algorithm or correlation-based function selection. On four distinct datasets, it was found that selecting a subset of bands with correlation-based function choice tended to result in development in type accuracy in evaluation by looking at the complete set of channels or simply the first essential additives. Furthermore, running the classifier on the selected band subset required considerably less time. It ended in a greater stable class accuracy than walking the type at the entire spectrum. Moreover, prediction possibilities decided using the classifier based totally on the selected bands had extended values in assessment with those using the entire spectrum or first primary components.

articleTitle: Plant Fettle Detector: Unifying Fruit Quality Tracking and Plant Disease Detection through Advanced Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: India being an agricultural country, food quality tracking is a major challenge faced by common farmers across the country. This research presents an innovative integration of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to address key challenges in agriculture—fruit quality tracking and plant disease detection. The unified system comprises the Fruit Quality Tracker and the Plant Disease Detector, leveraging advanced image analysis for precision agriculture. The Fruit Quality Tracker uses computer vision to assess ripeness and defects in real-time, empowering farmers with informed decisions. Simultaneously, the Plant Disease Detector swiftly identifies and classifies diseases, mitigating economic losses. The research explores architectural nuances, development methodologies, and deployment on Google Cloud Platform. Testing shows high accuracy rates of 98.5% for fruit quality and 98.83% for plant disease detection. The system's transformative potential in agriculture is highlighted, bridging the gap between technology and sustainable food production systems.

articleTitle: Automatically Suggesting Suitable Crop from Soil Samples Using Optimized Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: A soil-centric crop recommendation system recommends suitable crops utilizing vital soil attributes as input factors. This sophisticated system incorporates parameters like Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), Potassium (K) levels, temperature, humidity, pH, and rainfall to suggest ideal crops for cultivation. The dataset comprises diverse crops and their specific requirements for each input parameter. We implemented an optimized neural network to provide precise crop recommendations based on the provided input values. By analyzing this data, the system provides farmers with the information necessary to make well-informed decisions regarding their choice of crops, enhancing the potential for optimal yields. Our model performed well on training and testing data with an accuracy of 0.94. These results demonstrate its effectiveness and potential as a valuable tool for agricultural decision-making. This system offers farmers tailored recommendations based on soil properties, climatic conditions, and other environmental factors.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of State Grid Data Operation Management System Based on Stacking Integration Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: When transmitting operation management information with State Grid data as the carrier, iterative matching between State Grid data and operation management is the essence of operation management, and the factors affecting operation management are data structure, management mode, management effect, and interference of hardware and software. In this paper, a Stacking integration algorithm is proposed to optimize State Grid's data, management mode, and mapping structure, and the management level, security, and database rationality are verified. The accuracy of the optimization results is confirmed. The results show that the integrated Stacking algorithm has more than 90% accuracy in management level, security, and data structure calculation, and the operation and management time is less than 6min, which is significantly better than the previous management systems and meets the requirements of State Grid data operation and management.

articleTitle: Diabetes Classification Using XG Boost Classification Techniques Through Machine Learning based SMOTE Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Diabetes is a prevalent and enduring metabolic condition that has substantial health ramifications. The timely and precise categorization of patients into diabetes and non-diabetic groups is of utmost importance in order to facilitate efficient disease treatment. Machine learning methodologies, such as the XGBoost algorithm, have been recognised as very effective instruments in the field of diabetes categorization. This study investigates the use of XGBoost, a gradient boosting algorithm, in combination with the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) to tackle the issue of data imbalance in the categorization of diabetes. The use of algorithms in machine learning is of significant importance in the field of medical research and healthcare, since it enables the generation of predictions by analysing patient data. Within the domain of diabetes categorization, the task at hand is the development of a model that can effectively forecast an individual's diabetes state by considering pertinent factors such as age, body mass index (BMI), glucose levels, and genetic background. The XGBoost method is extensively used in the field of machine learning because to its notable efficiency and accuracy, especially in jobs involving categorization. The main aim of this study is to use the XGBoost classifier in order to categorise the diabetic illness. This will be achieved by using SMOTE Analysis to address the issue of imbalanced data and then analysing both balanced and unbalanced datasets. The forthcoming scholars in this particular area of investigation will get advantages from the notable degree of precision shown in this research.

articleTitle: Low Energy Data Aggregation Using Dynamic Time Warping Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Low-strength statistics aggregation is becoming increasingly popular because it permits the capture and garage of large amounts of facts in a green, price-powerful way. Several algorithms and strategies are used. Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is one such set of rules used to measure the similarity between two temporal sequences. In the context of records aggregation, DTW can be used to estimate the approximate similarity among exceptional sensors' readings so that you can correctly combine the data. It lets in for the evaluation of the subsequent statistics to be correct and designated. Moreover, a DTW-based total technique can also be used to offer an early-caution device for ability faults or device impairments in statistics-centric structures. It makes the technique one of the maximum beneficial and effective algorithms in low-strength statistics aggregation. A dynamic time warping (DTW) algorithm is used for low-power facts aggregation by way of calculating similarities between two collections of data factors. DTW measures similarity by accounting for shifts in time and warping the alignment to fit the two series collectively. This device is utilized in conditions where temporal alignment is only sometimes preserved. DTW compares the whole series' form and is a memory in-depth algorithm. It can perform statistics aggregation in instances with in-strength networks wherein records must be aggregated daily for complex decision-making. The advantage of this method is that it can be used to correctly integrate statistics from exceptional resources with a simple metric for assessment in low power and memory eventualities. By combining information from multiple assets, strength networks can make more knowledgeable decisions, taking into account a more excellent optimized and green electricity control..

articleTitle: Wav2Letter: Transforming Speech to Text with CNN for Automatic Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper introduces a straightforward approach to Automatic Speech Recognition(ASR) system that converts spoken language into written text, featuring a complete model that includes a convolutional neural network for the acoustic model. Unlike traditional methods that require aligning phonemes, our model is trained to directly output letters by transcribing speech. We’ve eliminated the need for force alignment. To achieve this, we’ve developed an automatic segmentation criterion for training. This criterion, which is as effective as the Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) method, allows us to train from sequence annotations without requiring explicit alignment. Our model produces competitive results in terms of word error rate when using the Librispeech corpus and Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) features. Additionally, we’ve obtained promising results when working directly with raw waveform data.

articleTitle: A hybrid Kmeans and ML Classification Approach for Credit Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Credit card fraud poses a significant threat to financial systems and requires advanced methods for timely and accurate detection. This research explores a hybrid approach to credit card fraud detection by combining unsupervised learning, specifically K-means clustering, with five diverse classification algorithmsRandom Forest, Decision Tree, K-NN SVCand Naive Bayes. The methodology involves using K-means clustering to group transactions based on their features and subsequently treating the cluster assignments as pseudo-labels for training the classification models. The aim is to leverage the strengths of both clustering and classification to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of fraud detection.A dataset from Kaggle was used for experiments. Initially, elbow method applied to find the suitable clusters for the given dataset. Later, KMeans applied for performing clustering of dataset. Later, classification algorithms applied for evaluating performance of the model. The proposed method utilized various measures to measure the effectiveness of the hybrid approach.The results reveal the potential of combining clustering and classification for credit card fraud detection, with each algorithm contributing unique insights into different aspects of the data.

articleTitle: Symphony of Health: AI Unveiling Lung Sound Secrets
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Respiratory disease has been a major contributor to deaths worldwide. Early prediction would help to improve the survivability of the patients. This paper deals with the evaluation of lung sounds as a primary step before determining the appropriate course of treatment. An integrated model is employed to detect various respiratory sounds. A Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and 2D convolution neural network is employed, in this work, to identify the lung sounds at early stages of anomaly. Machine Learning algorithms such as Random Forest and Support Vector Machine have been engaged to procure accurate classification of Lung sounds namely crackles, wheezes. The SVM model reported an impressive accuracy of 97.2% followed by Random Forest with accuracy of 96.7%. This innovative approach has the potential for early lung sound detection and classification, making it as a valuable tool for health care professionals.

articleTitle: Multi-Model Approach for Alzheimer Disease Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease is a leading cause of concern for an older demographic. The progression of the disease is marked by a decline in cognitive abilities and an inability to care for themselves. Hence, it is very important to detect Alzheimer’s disease in its early stages. The SVM and CNN are the models generally used for the detection and classification of Alzheimer’s disease which yielded promising results. In this work, SVM and EfficientNetB0 is used in tandem to improve the performance. The results obtained show that the proposed method gives better results as compared to individual models. As for CNN (EfficientNetB0), it has good performance with a more efficient use of resources by scaling the model’s depth, width, and resolution in a balanced manner. In this paper, we propose combining these two models where SVM and CNN are used together to get the best possible results.

articleTitle: Efficiency in the Cloud: A Deep Dive into the Integration of Artificial Intelligence for Enhanced Performance and Scalability
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: A research examines the mutually beneficial interaction between artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud computing, emphasizing the transformational power of AI on performance and scalability. A collaborative filtering recommendation system was created within an e-commerce platform, showcasing the concrete advantages of combining artificial intelligence with cloud services. The findings demonstrate a notable improvement in system performance, with a 30% decrease in reaction times for the tailored suggestion generation. Scalability of the cloud was essential for effectively controlling fluctuating user activity, guaranteeing maximum use of resources during high demand and avoiding underuse during low demand. The pay-as-you-go cloud computing approach was shown to be economical, leading to a 20% decrease in infrastructure expenses during periods of high demand.The training time of the recommendation model was cut in half by using cloud resources for parallel processing. This allowed data scientists to play with more complex algorithms and more datasets. With a 50% decrease in the time it took for users to get updated suggestions, real-time decision-making skills were achieved, which raised user engagement.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Methods of Artificial Intelligence Computer Processing Information
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: With the rapid development and practical application of computer technology, information processing technology is particularly important. Ordinary computer information processing technology has been slowly reformed and innovated under the rapid development of computer technology, and can not better process computer information. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent information processing technology for intelligent information processing analysis. Industrial intelligence (AI) has penetrated into every aspect of our life, especially in the field of computer information processing. With its high efficiency and intelligence, it is changing our work and life style.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Technique based Fault Diagnosis for Electrical Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The power system needs to operate reliably and efficiently, with the distribution system being a critical component. Distribution systems are prone to faults and malfunctions for several reasons. These issues can have a significant impact on the power grid, but their effects can be minimized quickly and accurately through fault diagnostics. Electric utilities face an ongoing challenge in promptly and precisely identifying and locating faults in the distribution system. AI tools can be an efficient method for accurately identifying these faults. There are several possible diagnostic methods, such as fuzzy logic, ANN (artificial neural network), ANFIS (adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system), support vector machines, genetic algorithms, and matching approaches. Each technique has its own advantages and disadvantages. The paper has employed fuzzy logic for fault detection, identification, and location. This paper includes the study of multiple faults on different buses. Also, the identification and location of multiple faults are included. The simulation and algorithm development have been carried out in MATLAB/Simulink. Thus, fault detection, identification, and location have been done through a fuzzy logic algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimizing Object Detection in YOLOv5 using Adaptive Genetic Algorithm: A Study on Population Sizes for Enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning-based object detection models like YOLOv5 have demonstrated remarkable efficiency in accurately identifying objects within images. However, achieving optimal performance still presents challenges. Many researchers have employed hybrid models to enhance the mean average precision (mAP) in the YOLOv5 architecture. However, only a few have explored hyperparameter-based optimization techniques to improve mAP. We use an adaptive genetic algorithm-based approach for analyzing Arecanut X-ray images to improve detection accuracy within the YOLOv5 framework. Balancing population size and computational efficiency is crucial for effective exploration and exploitation of the solution space in genetic algorithms without incurring unnecessary computational costs. This research investigates the influence of various population sizes on mAP using a genetic algorithm. Our findings indicate that a population size of 50 is ideal for achieving the best mAP among the explored sizes, when evolved for 300 generations.

articleTitle: Implementing Reversible and Lossless Data Hiding Within Encrypted Images
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In the realm of data protection, cryptography and steganography stand out as effective methods. Cryptography involves securing data through encryption and decryption processes, while steganography focuses on concealing data within other data. Combining these methodologies creates a strong approach for concealing data within encrypted images, enhancing overall security. Chaotic cryptography has gained prominence due to its effectiveness in encrypting and decrypting images. To reduce the compatibility challenges between certain data hiding techniques and chaotic cryptography, two types of process is devised and put into practice. The first method involves interpolation technique and Least Significant Bit (LSB) data hiding within the chaotic encryption framework. The interpolation technique enhances the compatibility of information insertion within encrypted images. LSB data hiding involves replacing LSB bits of pixels with the secret data. In the second method, a prediction error technique is done along with chaotic encryption. In this, significant effectiveness in securely hiding data within encrypted images is achieved. Chaotic encryption is integrated into both methods to guarantee the confidentiality and protection of the embedded data. In each method, the concealed data is seamlessly embedded within the encrypted image, and upon reception, the information can be accurately extracted. A comparative analysis is conducted based on various parameters, including Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity (SSIM), computation time, and embedding rate

articleTitle: Research on Human Activity Recognition Algorithm Based on Metric Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of computer technology, people's lives have been inseparable from high-tech technology, which can bring convenience to people. In the field of computer vision, human activity recognition is a very hot topic, basketball technology recognition, intelligent monitoring, intelligent security systems, etc. all need to use human activity recognition. Traditional recognition methods cannot solve the problem of accurate recognition of human activities in computer vision. Therefore, this paper proposes a measure learning for human activity recognition analysis. In the intelligent era, Human Activity Recognition (HAR) technology is like a beautiful landscape, spanning many research fields such as computer vision, pattern recognition and machine learning. With its unique charm, it attracts countless researchers to dig deep.

articleTitle: Blood Glucose Monitoring Based on Transmission using Microstrip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In this paper, a microstrip patch antenna is designed to be used as a sensor for a non-invasive glucose monitoring system. The suggested microstrip patch technology has several benefits over conventional glucose monitoring techniques, such as the elimination of frequent blood samples taken via finger prick and the ability to track glucose levels in real time. In the noninvasive method, a change in the dielectric constant of glucose is used as a new way to detect the blood glucose level. To acquire the best possible outcome for several blood glucose conditions, this research has simulated the antenna with three different phantoms to get the most accurate simulated accuracy. The deliberately designed three different methodologies—the ’Basic Skin Model’, ’Finger Model’, and ’Two Antenna Sandwich Model’ have been established and tested with glucose (0–500 moles/fraction) dielectric constant. The human tissue penetrates mostly between 1 and 10 GHz, so a microwave resonant sensor at a frequency of 7.00 GHz has been designed with a unique approach in this paper. The antenna has been designed with the substrate material ${\text{R}}04056\left( {\left( { \in _r^\prime } \right) = 3.55} \right)$ with substrate height 1.52mm. The simulated results can observe the variation of the resonant frequency in S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> with the changing dialectic Constant; while found that two antenna model has better reflection coefficient variation to observe.

articleTitle: Research on Line Loss Correction Method Based on Cluster Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In the process of line loss algorithm analysis, aiming at the problem that the relationship between line loss and correction data cannot be accurately obtained, an improved line loss algorithm combining line loss correction factor and line loss algorithm is proposed to reduce the influence of abnormal current and voltage on line loss correction results and improve the effect of line loss correction. The line loss of abnormal current and voltage was carried out using the k-means theory, and the irregular line loss judgment strategy was found for each line. Then, under the guidance of the k-means idea, the optimal line loss position is located. The simulation results show that the improved line loss algorithm can improve the accuracy of significant line loss correction under k-means, shorten the line loss judgment time of the entire power grid, and the line loss correction effect is better than that of the line loss method.

articleTitle: Cost Analysis and Sustainability of Electrical Vehicles Vs Internal Combustion Engine based Vehicles for Two Wheelers
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The global automotive industry is undergoing a transformative shift with the rising popularity of electric vehicles (EVs) as an eco-friendly alternative to the traditional Internal Combustion Engine based Vehicles (ICEVs). This paper presents a comparative cost analysis of EVs and ICEVs, examining their cost and potential implications for the transportation sector. A critcal point of 6 km has been observed in this study below which if the daily run of the vehicle falls, it will not be economical to opt for EVs otherwise if the daily run of the vehicle is above this critical point, there will be a wise decision to opt for EVs in comparison to the ICEVs.

articleTitle: Ensemble Model Object Detection Versus State-of-the-Art Approaches in Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: With an emphasis on improving object identification, segmentation, and context learning from video frames, research in video content detection has seen a notable upsurge in the last few years. While commonly used techniques like refining hyperparameters and updating base models have shown progress, several studies have established that cutting-edge models such as YOLO, ResNet, RetinaNet, EfficientNet, etc., have already attained high accuracy levels. Even with these developments, object detection in videos still faces difficulties with robustness, which motivates more research. To close the current research gap, this work suggests using model ensembling to improve detection accuracy. A thorough analysis of the models that are now accessible is done, emphasizing both their advantages and disadvantages. In particular, the research investigates the efficacy of assembling models, demonstrating advances in video object detection. Notably, YOLO in conjunction with ResNet and LSTM is a very interesting method that shows notable improvements in detection accuracy. This work opens the door to more reliable and accurate video content analysis by providing a thorough grasp of model ensemble approaches and their effects on video object detection.

articleTitle: Design of Information Teaching Management System based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The role of information system in teaching management is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate evaluation of results. The situational awareness algorithm cannot solve the problem of information system in teaching management, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a BP neural network for information system analysis. In today's era of rapid development of information technology, the field of education has also ushered in unprecedented changes. With the continuous progress of science and technology, neural network, as an important branch of artificial intelligence, has shown its unique charm and powerful ability in many fields.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of FinFET models based Ternary Half Subtractor
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The introduction of multivalue logics in the field of digital electronics has been recognized as a significant achievement, offering resolutions to the constraints imposed by binary logic. Within the field of multivalue logic, ternary logic is generally considered an innovative method. This article presents a comprehensive overview of the design of a ternary half subtractor using 18nm FinFET technology, implemented via the use of the Virtuoso tool offered by Cadence. The evaluation of the Subtractor's performance is carried out by a comparison of the results obtained using SVT and HVT FinFET models. The obtained simulation results reveal power consumption values of 33.70 and 27.76μW, transient delay values of 10.31 and 10.36ns, and power delay product values of 347.44 and 287.59 (x 10-15 J) for the SVT and HVT FinFET models, respectively. The proposed design of a ternary half subtractor has potential for energy efficiency in the context of data compression and error detection applications.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data in Computer Information Security Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Nowadays, network technology has made a qualitative leap and has also realized the universal use of networks, but because of the strengthening of technology, computer information security problems have also followed. Traditional information security processing technology can no longer meet the needs of today's information security, nor can it achieve the expected information security processing results. With the rapid development of information technology, the amount of data generation, storage and processing has increased exponentially, and the era of big data has arrived.

Author Keywords: Information security processing technology based on big data

articleTitle: Energy Harvesting using Conventional Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The nation’s needs for energy have increased with its development and growth. This paper is focused on design of Arduino based single axis solar panel tracking System. The main target of this paper is to produce as much as possible energy through Solar power and minimize the wastage of any useful resources. Most of the solar panels used in household to produce energy are aligned at fix angle due to which Sun rays are not always perpendicular to solar panels Throughout the day, especially during afternoon hours. It can produce maximum energy when it receives maximum intensity of Sun light, as the PV cells are directly under sun rays. To resolve that problem, Arduino UNO based single axis solar panel was implemented in the system. By implementing it, panel structure can change its alignment automatically according to change in Sun position and intensity of light, Which will make sure that PV cells stay aligned to sun. This concept will not only make solar panels more efficient but also other features that are implemented in the system will make whole concept of solar panels more greener, more efficient, and will ensure minimum loss of resources. Intensity measurement is done using LDR (light detecting resistor) sensors. Stepper motors are used to adjust the panel’s alignment to produce energy with maximum efficiency possible at each location. During rainy season, intensity of light is significantly less so power generation may be less. Next proposed technique is able to produce energy by water droplets which strike on piezoelectric sensor. Also adding another feature, the concept of the turbine is introduced in this model. The rain water which will fall on the back of the solar panel will free fall through the turbine and rotate it. Hence will convert Mechanical Energy to the Electrical Energy. In this paper we have integrated Conventional Green energy sources namely Single Axis Solar Panel, Piezo electric sensor and Dynamo for the purpose of energy harvesting.

articleTitle: Quality of Service (QoS) Motivated Cross-Layer Channel Allocation Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The pleasant of provider (quality of service) stimulated pass-layer channel allocation scheme is a novel technique for allocating channels between wireless community nodes. This approach makes use of QoS-based visitor type to determine the most suitable communique channels in a multi-channel Wi-Fi environment. The method relies on the usage of analytically calculated Time Interference (TI) values, which may be used as criteria for assessing the fine channel choice. The go-layer channel allocation scheme considers various put-off necessities, power necessities, and bitrates with the purpose of deciding the most suitable channel for verbal exchange. The proposed approach also supports the co-current of multiple radio interfaces inside the equal community. Furthermore, the proposed technique is anticipated to provide full-size throughput improvements when compared to the conventional unmarried-channel techniques.

articleTitle: Implementation of Secure Communication System using Various Chaotic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper conducts a comparative study among various chaotic systems, implementing a secure communication system. The chaotic communication system incorporates specific synchronization and masking schemes, contributing to achieving the objectives of secure communication. This comparative analysis aims to identify the optimal choice for this application, evaluating multiple crucial parameters integral to the design.The simulation for the design has been carried out in Xilinx Vivado using Verilog HDL.

articleTitle: Hybrid Perceptual Structural and Pixelwise Residual Loss Function based Image Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Single Image Super-Resolution (SISR) aims to generate high-resolution (HR) images from the low-resolution (LR) input images. Deep learning techniques have significantly improved the HR outputs. These techniques primarily use the Mean Squared Error (MSE) Loss function for training purposes which considers pixels and doesn’t take into account the structural information, textures, luminance, and contrast. These features play a crucial role in determining the perceptual quality of the image. Structural Similarity Index Metric (SSIM) can be manipulated to be used as a loss function that gives bright and well-structured HR images. However, this technique sometimes produces blurry and noisy HR outputs. To address this, a Hybrid Perceptual Structural and Pixel-wise Residual (HyPSPR) loss function approach has been introduced. This regularisation technique balances both factors. The Perceptual Structural (PS) Factor improves the structural information, textures, luminance, and contrast, while the Pixel-wise Residual (PR) Factor improves the encoded pixel-level information. A denoising and sharpening block in the model architecture has also been added to reduce the gaussian noise in the output.

articleTitle: Impact of Latent Space Dimension on IoT Botnet Detection Performance: VAE-Encoder Versus ViT-Encoder
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The rapid evolution of Internet of Things (IoT) technology has led to a significant increase in the number of IoT devices, applications, and services. This surge in IoT devices, along with their widespread presence, has made them a prime target for various cyber-attacks, particularly through IoT botnets. As a result, security has become a major concern within the IoT ecosystem. This study focuses on investigating how the latent dimension impacts the performance of different deep learning classifiers when trained on latent vector representations of the train dataset. The primary objective is to compare the outcomes of these models when encoder components from two cutting-edge architectures: the Vision Transformer (ViT) and the Variational Auto-Encoder (VAE) are utilized to project the high dimensional train dataset to the learned low dimensional latent space. The encoder components are employed to project high-dimensional structured .csv IoT botnet traffic datasets to various latent sizes. Evaluated on N-BaIoT and CICIoT2022 datasets, findings reveal that VAE-encoder based dimension reduction outperforms ViT-encoder based dimension reduction for both datasets in terms of four performance metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score for all models which can be attributed to absence of spatial patterns in the datasets the ViT model attempts to learn and extract from image instances.

articleTitle: The Benefits and Challenges of IoT in Supply Chain Management Based on SCOR Model for Innovation in Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The development of Internet of Things (IoT) in many fields has been improving rapidly and Supply Chain Management (SCM) is one of the fields where the implementation of IoT can have tremendous benefits for all the supply chain actors due to the nature of connectivity of IoT, this can be used for multiple processes of the supply chain according to the Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) model (PLAN, SOURCE, MAKE, DELIVER, RETURN) to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the processes. The purpose of writing this paper is to study which process of the SCOR model gains the most benefit from IoT and which process is the most challenging to implement IoT into. The method used in this research is systematic literature review by reviewing published publications with 3 study processes: "Study Found", "Candidate Study", "Selected Studies", with the selected studies having 35 publications, the result of this research is divided into each process of the SCOR model outlining the number of benefits and challenges, the DELIVER process gains the most benefits (20) while PLAN process has the most challenges (8) mostly due to the lack of plan to use IoT in SCM in a meaningful way. By listing the benefits and challenges, a trend of benefit and challenge can be found and innovations in technology can be made to address the trend of challenge, such as to integrate IoT with SCOR metrics and to integrate IoT with AI for a more accurate demand forecasting that can lead to lower costs in operation and better decision making.

articleTitle: Empowering Healthcare with AI: Advancements in Medical Image Analysis, Electronic Health Records Analysis, and AI-Driven Chatbots
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into healthcare has ushered in a new era of transformative advancements, addressing critical aspects such as Medical Image Analysis (MIA), Electronic Health Records (EHR), and AI-driven Chatbots. In this research paper, we present comprehensive developments in these domains, demonstrating their synergistic potential. In the realm of Medical Image Analysis, we have employed transfer learning techniques and harnessed diverse datasets, which include Pneumonia Chest X-Ray Images, and the Tuberculosis (TB) Chest X-ray Database, and the bone cancer Chest X-ray Database. Our models, built using transfer learning, have achieved remarkable accuracy, with some reaching an impressive 98.4% on the datasets collected from various sources. Notably, among the selected models, including InceptionV3, InceptionResNetV2, DenseNet121, DenseNet169, DenseNet201, ResNet50V2, ResNet101V2, VGG16, and VGG19. DenseNet201 has displayed exceptional performance, attaining an accuracy of 98.4%. The proposed work encapsulates significant advancements in AI within the healthcare domain, particularly in the fields of Medical Image Analysis, Electronic Health Records, and AI-driven Chatbots. Through rigorous experimentation and innovation, we demonstrate the potential to reshape healthcare delivery, diagnosis, and patient engagement. These developments underscore the transformative power of AI in redefining the healthcare landscape for the better.

articleTitle: Intelligent Data Management in Cloud Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The rapid growth of data in various domains has necessitated the need for efficient and intelligent data management techniques in cloud storage. This research paper explores the application of AI-driven approaches to enhance data accessibility, security, and performance in cloud storage systems.First, the paper investigates the challenges faced in traditional data management systems, such as limited accessibility, potential security vulnerabilities, and performance bottlenecks. These challenges are addressed by leveraging the power of artificial intelligence techniques.The research presents an overview of the role of AI in data management, including machine learning algorithms, natural language processing, and computer vision. These AI-driven approaches enable intelligent data classification, indexing, and retrieval, facilitating improved data accessibility in cloud storage environments.Furthermore, the paper discusses how AI can enhance security measures in cloud storage. It explores the use of AI-based anomaly detection algorithms to identify and mitigate potential security threats, such as unauthorized access, data breaches, and malicious activities. AI-driven encryption techniques are also explored to strengthen data protection in cloud storage.In addition to accessibility and security, the research paper delves into AI-driven techniques to optimize the performance of cloud storage systems. It investigates the application of machine learning algorithms for intelligent resource allocation and workload balancing, leading to enhanced system performance and reduced latency.Overall, this research paper highlights the significance of intelligent data management in cloud storage and showcases the potential of AI-driven approaches to address the challenges associated with data accessibility, security, and performance. The findings of this study can assist cloud service providers, researchers, and practitioners in developing more efficient and robust data management solutions in the era of big data and cloud computing.

articleTitle: Applying Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning to Identify Neglected Tropical Skin Disorders
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Visual inspection plays a significant role in the identification of skin diseases, albeit it is not the only method. Teledermatology techniques are thus particularly suitable for the diagnosis and treatment of these disorders. In vision tasks, deep learning (DL), a subset of machine learning (ML) and/or artificial intelligence (AI), has produced outstanding results. There has been few research in this field, and even fewer that have focused on dark skin, despite the growing interest in using this technology to improve diagnostics for neglected tropical diseases affecting the skin (skin NTDs). In this work, we used clinical photos to create AI models based on deep learning. In order to determine whether or not various models with training patterns can increase diagnosis accuracy. The five skin NTDs in which data were gathered were yaws, scabies, mycetoma, leprosy, and Buruli ulcer.

articleTitle: Anticipating Threats through Malware Detection Approaches to safeguard Data Privacy and Security: An In-Depth Study
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Although automated security tools and security analysts currently manage to handle approximately 80% of cyber threats on a global scale, the remaining 20% poses a significant risk. Among the most prevalent threats, malware stands out as a particularly concerning one due to its self-propagating nature and the unresolved vulnerabilities are exploited by malicious actors. In this study, various approaches are explored to combat malware, ranging from static and dynamic analysis techniques to signature-based, heuristic-based, behavior-based, model checking-based, cloud-based, machine learning and deep learning-based, mobile device-based, and IoT-based approaches. By conducting a comprehensive comparison and analysis of these methodologies, we aim to identify the techniques that can be proved to be most effective to mitigate the risks associated with various malwares. The findings and results obtained from this study contribute to the development of more robust strategies for maintaining a secure cyber environment.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of RESTFUL Web Services and RABBITMQ for Microservices based Systems on Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Nowadays, every other company is switching or wants to switch from monolithic to microservices architecture, which comes with its own set of challenges. One major challenge is inter-service communication, because when we think of microservices, we expect a collection of separate services communicating with one another to provide the desired output/result and making the system functional in the expected way. There are various modes of communication and at times selecting the appropriate mechanism for interservice communication could be difficult for developers/architects, as it is critical to the overall functionality and performance of the application. The purpose of this research is to compare synchronous RESTful web services and asynchronous RabbitMQ for microservices based systems on cloud ecosystem, exploring their key features, advantages and disadvantages, and evaluating their performance in different use cases on cloud.

articleTitle: Mental Fitness Tracker Using Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Mental health plays an important role in human health affecting many aspects of life. However, evaluating and improving mental well-being is not an easy task because it involves many complex and unique elements. In this work, we employ artificial intelligence (AI) technology to propose a novel approach to track and enhance mental health. Our solution, called Mental Fitness Tracker, is a web-based application that tracks and analyzes user behavior, emotions, and mental health indicators using a range of data sources, such as social media, wearable technologies, online questionnaires, and natural language processing. In light of the data analysis, the program provides users with individualized recommendations, guidance, and actions to enhance their mental health.

Author Keywords: Linear Regression and Random Forest regression

articleTitle: Limited Vocabulary Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems play an major role in recognizing spoken language, enabling seamless human-machine interaction. This paper proposes a new ASR model which is adapted for limited vocabulary scenarios that optimizes speech recognition accuracy and performance. This model uses a special datasets of human voice recordings containing a limited subset of vocabulary. Using advanced machine learning techniques, that includes deep neural networks and possibly convolution neural networks (CNNs), the proposed system aims to capture the variations in human speech patterns. Using a datasets of different human voice or speech samples, the ASR model goes through training, validation and testing stages to predict the corresponding text. This paper mainly Focus on a limited vocabulary allows greater accuracy in identifying and transcribing certain commonly used words.

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s Disease Prediction Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The brain anatomy is studied by Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). In order to take preventive measures that are necessary, early diagnosis of patients affected by Alzheimer’s disease(AD) is more essential. The most prevalent illness affecting the old people is AD. For the diagnosis of AD, numerous, intricate segmentation methods have been presented. Deep Learning (DL) techniques have attracted interest for the technique of segmenting the anatomy of the brain and categorizing AD because they can produce efficient results over a vast data collection. How the knowledge of brain anatomy can be used to identify AD using concepts from convolutional neural networks are explained. New methods, their outcomes on public datasets, and the advantages of MRI segmentation of brain for classification of AD is described. This work investigates the potential use of DL techniques to enhance and strengthen early diagnosis, predict AD phases as mild, moderate, low, or medium, and investigate strategies for strengthening overall performance analysis.

articleTitle: Prediction of Cyberbullying Attacks on Twitter Data using ANN and NLP
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: As cyberbullying has become more common, people are becoming more worried about the damage it may do to individuals and communities. This work aims to develop a model for predictive analysis that can scour Twitter data for patterns and foretell occurrences of cyberbullying. Therefore, a novel framework with a hybrid of ANN and NLP model is proposed to assess Twitter data. The proposed hybrid ANN-NLP model is fine-tuned by using the Vectorizer algorithm to detect and classify instances of cyberbullying more accurately. The efficiency of the proposed model is experimented on a dataset that has abusive or otherwise inappropriate language. The model exhibited better performance metrics in terms of precision, recall, f1-score and accuracy. The hybrid ANN-NLP model obtained an accuracy of 91% when compared with other classical methods. The results provide light on the features and patterns of cyberbullying and are useful for detecting crimes.

articleTitle: Study of Energy cost optimization for Integration of Microgrid to Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The increasing adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) and renewable energy sources has revolutionized the energy landscape, which has lead to new opportunities and challenges for energy cost optimization and sustainable energy management. This paper presents a comprehensive approach for optimizing energy costs through the seamless integration of a microgrids (PV solar panels, wind turbines, battery energy storage system (BESS), and diesel generator). The primary objective is to meet the energy demands of 200 households, including the charging requirements of EVs, while minimizing overall energy costs. The proposed methodology leverages Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) to formulate a mathematical model that effectively balances energy generation, storage, and consumption. The results of this study demonstrates the potential it has to reduce energy costs, through increased utilization of renewable energy sources. Additionally, the proposed approach enhances the reliability of the microgrid by efficiently managing the interplay between various energy resources and EVs, thus ensuring uninterrupted power supply to households.

articleTitle: Use of the Usability Scale System as a Monitoring Dashboard Test for Inpatient Covid-19 Patients in Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: With the global outbreak of the coronavirus (Covid-19), the world health situation has been shaken by a major crisis caused by its rapid spread and serious impact on public health. In this context, it is becoming increasingly important to develop technological solutions that can support efforts to deal with Covid-19, especially in the hospital environment. This study aims to design and develop a monitoring system in the form of a Covid-19 patient dashboard that will be integrated with hospital management information systems and the Internet of Things (IoT). The development approach used is the Prototyping process model. This system aims to provide real-time information about the patient's condition to medical personnel while continuously monitoring the patient's vital signs. The hope is that this system can ease the workload of hospitals in treating Covid-19 patients. Evaluation of system usability is carried out through the use of the System Usability Scale (SUS) to measure the extent to which this system can be utilized. The evaluation results with a SUS score of 81.5 indicate that the dashboard has a high level of acceptance among users. Users generally feel comfortable and able to use the system well. This shows that the system has the potential to be well-received by users and meet user needs.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Part of Speech(POS) Tagger for Gujarati Language using Deep Learning and Pre-Trained LLM
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Part of the Speech tagger takes the language word and tags it with grammar tags like nouns, verbs, and adjectives. Part of Speech Tagger(POS) is an important and useful aspect of Natural Language Processing(NLP).POS tagger is mature enough for the English language but much work needs to be done for the low-resource languages.POS tagging helps to understand the morphology of a particular language. We have applied the pre-trained LLM model BERT, RNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, and NLTK’s prebuilt method on the Gujarati dataset for the comparative analysis. A major chunk of the Gujarati dataset was collected from the online source while some of the tagging tasks we have performed, totaling 29813 sentences and their tags were collected.RNN, LSTM surpasses the BERT and gives good accuracy because the BERT LLM is not trained on the Part of Speech Tagging task. Recurrent Neural Network(RNN) gives the highest accuracy which accounts for 98.02% as BERT gives 88% accuracy.

articleTitle: A 86 mW of Power, 1.57 dB of Noise Figure, Low-IF CMOS Receiver Front End for Sub-6 GHz Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In this work, the functionality and performance of low-IF receiver is studied using a RF frequency band of 3.4-3.45 GHz and LO frequency of 3.4 GHz. The low noise amplifier, mixer, low pass filter, buffer, sample and hold, analog to digital converter is integrated. The simulations were performed using 40 nm RF CMOS technology. The performance in terms of noise figure, power gain and power consumption are compiled to compare the performance of the receivers that are available in literature. The low IF receiver frontend has been used and investigated for sub 6 GHz applications. In the first stage three stage LNA where the output is taken differentially and the second stage is mixer in IF architecture and mixer is connected to filter. The last stage is a four bit flash ADC, and the output is taken differentially. The power and noise figure of the receiver is approximately 86mW and 1.57dB respectively.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization of Pt/ZnO Schottky UV Photodetector with Al Ohmic Contact
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The demand for high-performance optoelectronic devices continues to drive research toward new materials and device designs. This research focuses on the simulation and optimization of platinum (Pt)/zinc oxide (ZnO) Schottky photodetectors with aluminum (Al) ohmic contact, employing Silvaco Atlas TCAD simulations to design and analyze the photodetector in the ultraviolet (UV) spectrum region. ZnO, renowned for its wide bandgap and exceptional electronic characteristics, serves as the semiconductor photosensitive material, while Pt and Al are employed as the Schottky and ohmic contacts, respectively. The study aims to unravel the underlying physics governing the optoelectronic behavior of Pt/ZnO Schottky UV photodetector. The simulation results demonstrate superior performance, with a low dark current density (J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dark</inf>) of 8.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">–11</sup> pA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, better photocurrent density (J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">light</inf>) of 0.26 μA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> along with a remarkable J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">light</inf>/J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dark</inf> ratio of 3.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>, 3-dB cut-off frequency of 85.4 GHz, external quantum efficiency of 90.41%, external photocurrent responsivity of 0.26 A/W, detectivity of 1.55×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup> cmHz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>/W, and rapid photoswitching rise (fall) time of 71 (71) ps at a bias of –1.0 V. This research not only deepens the understanding of fundamental device principles but also offers a roadmap for engineers and researchers working towards the development of advanced optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: NeuroSafe-Advancing Mental Health using AI, ML and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This study offers a novel platform for mental health support that incorporates state-of-the-art technology to improve user experience. The platform analyzes user journals using BERT-based emotion analysis, and it generates weekly reports that show emotional trends. By utilizing blockchain technology, individuals can grant and withdraw therapist access as needed, while also ensuring safe record-keeping. Therapists can promote cooperative and private treatment by safely uploading session recordings to the blockchain. Real-time help is provided via a generative AI-based chatbot that makes use of LSTM and Seq2Seq architectures, and peer interactions are facilitated by a community chat app. The platform’s usefulness is demonstrated by the results, and user feedback validates its influence on mental health assistance. This project creates a user-centric framework that integrates blockchain security, emotion analysis, and AI-driven interactions to provide a holistic approach to mental health.

articleTitle: Simulating MAGeI3-Based Solar Cells Through Numerical Analysis with Varying Absorber Layer Thickness
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Lead-free solar cells have shown potential in the photovoltaic (PV) sector, with MAGeI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (Methylammonium Magnesium Triiodide) emerging as a promising material. Nevertheless, PV devices using MAGeI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> are now exhibiting suboptimal performance, failing to attain the desired level of conversion efficiency.
