abstract: This study provides a thorough analysis of a system of classification intended to identify five different illnesses that impact sweet potato leaves. The model demonstrates Notable performance metrics, which uses a complex architecture with three convolution layers, three max-pooling layers, and one fully linked layer. The accuracy of optimistic predictions is indicated by precision values between 88.73% and 91.78%, while the proportion of real positives properly anticipated is indicated by recall values between 86.11% and 91.78%. The F1-Score falls between 87.32% and 91.78%, weighing recall and precision. The model's accuracy, which ranges from 95% to 97% for each illness class, is impressive. The model's overall efficacy is further supported by aggregated measures, where macro, weighted, and micro averages consistently show excellent ratings. In order to improve agricultural productivity and food security, this study highlights the potential of using cutting-edge convolutional neural network architectures for the accurate and dependable classification of sweet potato leaf diseases.

articleTitle: Collaborative Computing: Federated Learning CNNs for Jute Leaf Disease Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper looks at how we find and put jute leaf diseases into a large-scale learning system with convolutional neural networks (CNN). Jute leaves are afflicted by five major groups of diseases. It uses information from five different users, each creating a shared system where everyone learns together. This method deals with privacy issues with data and utilizes a variety of different datasets to make the CNN model stronger. The study primarily uses methods for averaging in federated learning, including big and small averaging and weighted averaging. These help turn local data into a shared-world model that works over time. Each client's results are carefully studied to show how effectively the federated learning model performs in real-life farming situations. In the results, the model did well for all types of illnesses without any significant changes. The big averages for classes ey-1 to ey-5 were 79.92% and 80.3%, amounting to eighty-three sixties and seventy-six percent, respectively. These numbers show that the model works well for different diseases. The mixed percentages, which take into account how often each class is found in the data set, were somewhat lower. However, they were still strong. They had numbers of 79.87% for ey-1, growing to 80.22% for ey-2, then reaching up to 83.67% for ey to reach 5 levels and wow, what an The small averages, which show the model's total correctness, were very close to the measured ones. This proved it worked well and stayed on track. In the end, this study shows how federated learning with CNN can manage agricultural diseases. It focuses on classifying jute leaf problems using these methods.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Fisherface Techniques DLDA, PDLDA to Avoid SSS Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Numerous variables can affect the onset and course of pneumonia, making it a complicated disease. Pneumonia data has high dimensionality and noise, which makes data analysis difficult. This work describes a way for finding hidden patterns in chest X-ray pictures of patients with pneumonia by utilizing the Random Forest algorithm in conjunction with several Fisher face Techniques, including DLDA and PDLDA. One well-known difficulty that might occur when utilizing LDA (Linear Discriminant Analysis) for data analysis is the small sample size (SSS) problem. This issue arises when there are more variables (features) in the data than there are samples, making it impossible to estimate the covariance matrix. To address the intrinsic difficulties of Small Sample Size (SSS) in chest X-ray datasets, two methods are used in the data space: Direct Linear Discriminant Analysis (DLDA) and Parameterized Direct Linear Discriminant Analysis (PDLDA). The study looks at how well DLDA and PDLDA work to reduce high-dimensional data and extract discriminative characteristics from chest X-ray analysis. After that, the chest X-ray pictures are categorized using the Random Forest classification method according to the characteristics that were retrieved.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of a Medical Chatbot Built on BERT Language Model for Remote Health Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Telemedicine refers to delivering healthcare services, including diagnosis, treatment, and consultations, remotely through digital communication tools such as video calls, phone calls, and online messaging. Access to quality healthcare remains a significant challenge in underserved rural areas worldwide. Due to transportation issues and financial support in remote areas, people can only visit hospitals close to their location. Current telemedicine applications provide video conversations with doctors but need more seamless services due to the huge population increase in cities and the unavailability of internet services for people in rural areas. This article presents a medical chatbot application trained on a customized health assistant corpus to generate fast responses in text format to queries related to common health issues. The solution is built on the BERT model to train the chatbot, which includes MLM and NSP, which is one of the best ways to obtain accurate results. The BERT model trained on customized health assessment corpus consists of multiple health assessment corpora and health assistant queries/responses collected from different sources and achieved 96.5% test accuracy. Since the model is pre-trained, it will generate the response as fast as possible. In addition to that, the application provides 24/7 availability, user-friendly interfaces, remote monitoring, and robust data security.

articleTitle: Smart GPS Based Vehicle Speed Limit Controller on zone identification using Geo-Fencing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In light of growing concerns about road safety and the surge in traffic accidents, this project aspires to an Internet of Things smart GPS-based vehicle speed limit controller system. The primary objective is to elevate road safety by harnessing real-time data and automated control mechanisms to enforce speed limits, thereby diminishing incidents of speeding-related accidents. This project adopts a comprehensive approach, integrating both hardware and software components. Vehicle-mounted sensors, encompassing speed sensors and GPS receivers, continually gather real-time data on vehicle speed and location. Furthermore, road condition data is sourced from multiple outlets, such as weather stations and traffic cameras. This data is wirelessly transmitted to a central control unit, which processes and analyzes it. The control unit deploys machine learning algorithms to evaluate vehicle speed limits against predefined speed limits for specific road segments. Depending on this analysis, it transmits control signals back to the vehicle when necessary. These signals can encompass driver warnings, power limitations, or autonomous speed control. These methodologies collectively enabled the creation of an intelligent and adaptable GPS-based vehicle speed control system, offering the potential to significantly enhance road safety by dynamically enhancing road safety regulating vehicle speeds in different zones, ensuring the safety of people and drivers alike. The Smart GPS-based vehicle speed limit controller system has undergone successful development and testing, both in controlled environments and on public roads. The outcomes manifest a remarkable reduction in incidents of speeding and an enhanced adherence to speed limits, exhibiting an accuracy level exceeding 96%. In real-world scenarios, the system effectively mitigates speeding-related risks, leading to a substantial decline in traffic accidents. Its ability to adapt to changing road conditions and. Its scalability renders it a promising solution for future smart transportation systems.

articleTitle: Sports Risk Prediction and Evaluation Model Based on Single Layer Feed Forward Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Today, sports are promoted by the government and widely participated in by citizens; the system are considered healthy and important. Sport-related illnesses, injuries, and premature deaths can have a devastating effect on a person's bodily and mental health if the system aren't prepared for them. Data preprocessing, feature selection, and model training make up the first three stages of the suggested methodology. Due to the potential for erroneous inferences to be drawn from the analysis of data that has not been fully reviewed, data pre-processing is an essential part of the data mining process. Because even a small amount of data loss during feature selection can have a significant effect on a system's performance, the proposed approach use PCA to reduce the size of the original indexes. When features have been extracted, the data is used to train MLCNN-BiGRU models. The proposed method outperforms GRU and BiGRU, two prominent competing methods.

articleTitle: Interpreting the Evidence on Life Cycle to Improve Educational Outcomes of Students Based on Generalized ARC-GRU Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Research on the effects of teachers' fatigue on students' learning has been significantly less common than research on the effects of teachers' fatigue on teachers' own performance. Therefore, the purpose of this research is to see if teachers' emotional weariness has any bearing on their students' performance in the classroom. Consideration is given to a student's grades and their impressions of whether or not the system receive assistance from teachers, as well as to the student's general outlook on school, confidence in their own abilities, and faith in the availability of faculty support. Data preparation, feature extraction, and model training are the first steps in the proposed approach. Indicators of the quality of the education being provided are eliminated (by outlier removal and feature scaling). k-mean clustering approach is a technique of clustering which is commonly used in feature extraction. Following feature extraction, GARCH-GRU models are trained. The proposed approach is superior to two popular alternatives, ARCH and GRU. Using the provided method, the system were able to achieve a maximum accuracy of 97.07%.

articleTitle: Optimizing Citrus Disease Prediction: A Hybrid CNN-SVM Approach for Enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) were expertly combined in this study to create a powerful hybrid model for the automated diagnosis of citrus diseases. This model was developed as a result of this research. The model, which is comprised of three convolutional layers, three max-pooling layers, and two fully connected layers, displays remarkable performance across a variety of citrus illnesses, including Citrus Canker, Citrus Greening, Melanose, Citrus Scab, Alternaria Brown Spot, and Phytophthora Root Rot. In addition, the model is characterized by its three convolutional layers. The analysis of the layer parameters highlights the significance of the selected architecture in terms of optimizing predictive capabilities. The hybrid strategy, which achieves this result by methodically utilizing CNN for the purpose of feature extraction and SVM for the purpose of classification, obtains an accuracy of 92.34% overall. The execution of the technique in stages provides a methodical and exhaustive process of model development, which ultimately results in improved disease prediction accuracy. Beyond the citrus orchard, this study makes a contribution to the landscape of precision agriculture by arguing for the incorporation of cutting-edge machine learning models into contemporary agricultural methods. This research serves as a model for harnessing innovative technologies to boost production and build sustainable disease management techniques, which is particularly useful at a time when the agricultural industry is facing new and evolving issues.

articleTitle: Emotion-Aware Text to Speech: Bridging Sentiment Analysis and Voice Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper delves into the multifaceted realm of speech synthesis, focusing on challenges and opportunities in synthesizing speech from expressive corpora and mastering voice impersonation. Audiobooks, rich sources for speech synthesis, introduce variability in voice characteristics, necessitating nuanced approaches for unit-selection and statistical parametric speech synthesis. Voice impersonation, a complex phenomenon, involves intuitively mimicking another's voice, yet quantifying elusive elements poses challenges. Despite Text-to-Speech (TTS) advancements, expressive speech synthesis remains challenging, prompting exploration into emotions, speaking styles, and character voices. This study specifically concentrates on Emotion-Aware Text to Speech, emphasizing the usage of Hidden Markov Model (HMM) algorithm and the Hidden Markov Model Toolkit (HTK). Addressing voice variability, impersonation challenges, and expressive synthesis, the paper aims to enhance the authenticity of synthesized speech, advancing capabilities for human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Bifrost : No-Code ETL Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In today’s world where mobile and web application usage is ubiquitous, a notable increase in data generation demands skilled management in order for organizations to expand. In this data-driven environment, Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) procedures play a crucial role in coordinating the smooth flow of data from various sources to analytics systems. Businesses use enterprise data lifecycle management (ETL) pipelines to extract data from a variety of sources, such as cloud computing and databases (SQL/NoSQL), which contain structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data in a variety of formats. After that, the data is transformed to match destination schemas, like cloud storage and data warehouses, where it is kept for analysis. But creating these ETL pipelines from scratch for every application takes a significant amount of time and money. This research study presents a brand-new no-code ETL tool with an easy-to-use drag-and-drop pipeline creation interface in order to solve this problem. To create a data flow that is efficient from source to destination, users can design pipelines with ease by choosing sources, defining necessary transformations, defining targets, and connecting these elements. In addition to streamlining pipeline development, the suggested system makes effective planning and storing for later use easier. This makes it an affordable and time-saving solution for businesses navigating the complexities of data management in the ever-evolving world of technology.

articleTitle: Automated Multi-Choice Question Answering System using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Machine reading comprehension not only involves reading unstructured text but also understanding it. Compared to questions of a simpler kind, this job calls for more sophisticated reading comprehension, such as logical reasoning, summarizing, and computation. They demand the intelligent system's ability to understand human language, making it an essential tool for testing its capabilities. We used unstructured corpora such as ARC corpora and Aristo mini corpora as contexts to answer multiple choice questions, which are indexed using ElasticSearch API. To answer multiple choice questions, we assigned questions from subjects such as Chemistry, and Biology; The goal is to target science-related questions instead of general questions, as they are clearly more difficult to answer. We have developed an automated multiple choice question answering template that is deployed on localhost using the Flask framework; the model accepts a question followed by a series of answer choices, and there is a PDF file upload function where the user can also upload a PDF file containing a question or a set of questions followed by a pair of candidate answers options. Searching the corpus for the appropriate context for each question is an important part of answering the question, using discriminators such as the answer discriminator and the document discriminator, because it was found that the TF-IDF score alone does not always provide the result. The best possible documents to answer the question in hand. UnifiedQA was used for modeling and a model without discriminators was also made to compare the results, and it was found that with discriminators, better performance was achieved at the expense of computational speed. A current increase of up to 7% was observed, which is huge, so better context has been shown to improve model performance and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Survey of Caching Techniques for General Purpose Graphics Processing Units
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: General Purpose Graphics Processing Units (GP-GPUs) are emerging as a very powerful approach in the era of multi-cores. These processors typically employ multiple cores and use thousands of threads, they exploit the data parallelism inherent in GP-GPU applications. There has been an increasing interest in L1 data caches in GPUs. With the emergence of GP-GPU applications, L1 data caches have become performance critical. Typically the L1 data cache is private to each core or a symmetric multiprocessor. In this paper we comprehensively review the literature on using L1 data cache for GP-GPU applications. One of the earliest work[1] on exploiting locality explores throttling the number of threads thereby making the L1 data cache more efficient. There have been numerous follow-up works on making the L1 Data cache more efficient[2], [3], [4], [5], [6]. One of the most recent works[7] explores a L1 data cache that us shared between the cores. They in their study observe tremendous reuse of data across the private L1 data caches of each core. They propose a architecture that shares the private L1 data cache in a manner such that the reuse is minimized. In this paper we qualitatively compare all these techniques and discuss the advantages and disadvantages of each of these techniques and provide a comprehensive qualtiative comparison.

articleTitle: MetaCampus: Advancing Online Education with Virtual Classroom
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In recent years, the world has experienced online style of schooling. In case of bad weather conditions or pandemic events like COVID-19, schools and universities changes to online form of instruction. Tools like Zoom call or Google Meet were used. These tools, although being a significant tool for enabling remote learning, pose problems such as reduced attention, interruptions, restricted involvement, screen fatigue, lack of interaction and teacher burnout. Virtual reality technologies are promising to effectively enrich our daily lives. Enhancing learning experiences with virtual reality technologies is one of important paths to make the technologies affect our daily lifestyle, because students in classes need not come together in the same spot. With the use of virtual reality (VR), students may attend lessons from anywhere at any time, feeling as though they are in the same classroom. Moreover, virtual reality technologies can bring extra effects that cannot be reproduced in current virtual class rooms. The study suggests VR Classroom that offers a virtual place where students and a teacher virtually remain in the same spot. VR Classroom also includes numerous options to inspire students through engaging features.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning Based Autism Detection in Children
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), is a multifaceted neurodevelopmental condition, exhibiting a diverse array of symptoms and varying degrees of severity, which distinguishes it as a particularly complex and unique disorder. Autism affects communication, social interaction, and behavior, often resulting in difficulties related to making eye contact, comprehending social cues, and verbal communication. Initial indicators, like speech and language developmental delays, challenges with maintaining eye contact, and repetitive behaviors, provide valuable diagnostic information. The diagnostic process is aided by the utilization of Facial Image Data. The whole purpose of this work is to enhance the precision of autism diagnosis by using Transfer Learning technique on facial feature classification. To achieve this goal, Famous pre-trained models like ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0 were used on Autism Dataset which contains facial images of Autistic and Non-Autistic children. The performance possessed by these models were considerably good, Resenet-18 has achieved highest accuracy of 84.67% on test data and EfficientNet-B0 showing an accuracy of 80.67%.

articleTitle: An Efficient Framework for Integrating DevOps Practices in Network Configuration and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Through a systematic review of existing DevOps and Networking literature, this research provides a comprehensive reference architecture, including configuration and monitoring elements. Notably, our contribution involved executing an experiment aimed at understanding the potential impact of this architecture on network downtime reduction. In analyzing the unique challenges, the networking industry faces when implementing DevOps practices, we distilled these issues into an overview, intended to increase understanding and facilitate solutions.One of our primary achievements is the development and demonstration of a novel approach to implement DevOps. It innovatively utilizes a skeletal test environment, prioritizing continuous monitoring via observability and SDN controllers. By focusing on risk mitigation and ensuring optimal rollbacks, when necessary, we have helped to dramatically decrease the resources needed for these operations. This work anticipates easing the adoption of DevOps practices in the networking industry, thus paving the way for enhanced efficiency and productivity.

articleTitle: Study of Home Energy Management (HEM) Considering Grid-Integrated Solar
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Home Energy Management (HEM) is one of the significant applications in the innovation of smart grids, and this concept proficiently actualizes the end user. Energy management is a significant problem in electrical systems regarding energy efficiency and upcoming grid configurations. HEM plays a vital position in meeting the energy requirements of residential appliances. In this research, a cascaded boost converter with maximum voltage gain is developed as a component of innovative home solutions to minimize energy losses and enhance energy efficiency by up to 95%. Photovoltaic (PV) panels may get exposed to different degrees of solar irradiance and temperature under various climatic conditions. Thus, tracking the solar panel's most extreme power point is crucial to enhance the system's performance. Therefore, a modified Perturb and Observe with drift loop Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm is utilized in this research to extract the most extremely accessible PV power. HEM configuration comprises a solar panel, cascaded boost converter, modified P&O Algorithm, battery, bidirectional converter, and the inverter connected with the utility grid. This study simulated the proposed model in MATLAB/Simulink package, and the results were compared and discussed.

articleTitle: Smart Contract Security: A Review with a Focus on Decentralized Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Decentralized finance, or DeFi, has become the dominating application category on public blockchains like Ethereum. DeFi allows users to lend, borrow, collateralize, and exchange using smart contracts for a cheap cost of trust, unlike traditional finance. However, DeFi's openness creates a large attack surface, threatening players' funds. This paper introduces BLOCKEYE, a real-time threat detection technology for Ethereum DeFi deployments. Two essential aspects of BLOCKEYE handle this challenge: (1) Automated security analysis identifies vulnerable DeFi projects. To detect external manipulation of essential service states like asset prices, this technique uses symbolic reasoning on their data flow. (2) Offchain transaction monitor for susceptible DeFi projects. This monitor captures transactions not only for the target project but also for associated projects, providing further security analysis. BLOCKEYE alerts you to potential attacks when it detects system invariants like quick and disproportionate benefit to cost. Successfully applying BLOCKEYE to prominent DeFi projects has revealed previously unreported security attacks. The system's real-time analysis and detection improves DeFi ecosystem security, protecting user funds and decentralized financial platforms.

articleTitle: Enhancing Microservices Efficiency: Integrating Adaptive Learning for Automated Scaling in Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Cloud services have experienced rapid growth, leading to an escalation in challenges related to service monitoring and resulting in higher maintenance costs. The size of cloud applications has expanded, and the workload on the cloud system application fluctuates over time, progressively increasing. The cloud's capability to manage additional resources and relinquish them during periods of inactivity is a valuable feature. However, traditional monolithic applications pose difficulties in terms of maintenance. To address this issue, the transformation of cloud applications into microservices has proven effective. Microservices comprise heterogeneous services with intricate communication patterns, aiming to enhance scalability and facilitate flexible provisioning. This paper proposes the integration of adaptive learning into Cloud Watch, enabling automatic, data-driven scaling decisions. This approach enhances the cost- and time-effectiveness of microservices, presenting a solution to the challenges associated with managing monolithic applications.

articleTitle: A Framework for Epileptic Seizure Monitoring Based on IoT and Machine Learning Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent, unprovoked seizures that affects millions of people globally. The unpredictable nature of seizures in epilepsy necessitates vigilant monitoring of these patients to mitigate the risk of adverse events, including physical injury, that may occur during convulsive seizures. It is essential in handling cases of epilepsy that episodes be detected and patient data be stored for later examination. The Internet of Things (IoT) is a potentially revolutionary development in the medical industry since it makes it possible to collect data from individuals using biosensors. This information is then sent to a remote server or cloud storage where it can be analyzed by machine learning software. This article reviews epilepsy patient monitoring IoT platforms and systems that use machine learning and deep learning. It also discusses new research that has greatly used these technologies in monitoring and seizure detection. The most effective sensor devices for detecting and monitoring seizures are also highlighted, and information on the most prevalent kinds of epilepsy types is provided.

articleTitle: A Novel Artificial Intelligence based Approach for Diagnosis of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Healthcare sector is one of the most critical sectors due to its immense contribution towards the well being of individuals, public health and socio-economic development. Due to several considerable reasons, respiratory problems have increased tremendously.Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) has emerged as a prominent contributor to global mortality. The literature has witnessed that the integration of data analytics and artificial intelligence has the potential to enhance COPD diagnosis and management. For this study, the dataset has been created using the two major sources National Institute of Health, USA and National Center for Biotechnology Information, USA. After creating a merged dataset on the basis of common identified features, A SVM+ ResNet50 Hybrid Predictive Model has been proposed. The model has successfully classified the disease with the accuracy of 93 %. This research work can assist pulmonologist for timely diagnosis of disease.

articleTitle: Applying Deep Neural Networks to Sentiment Analysis in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have currently been applied to sentiment evaluation responsibilities in social media, attaining advanced overall performance compared to conventional machine mastering techniques. That is due to the truth that DNNs are capable of analyzing representations via non-linear function maps, permitting them to seize the complex semantic relationships in textual content correctly. DNNs are also perfect for natural language processing (NLP) obligations because they can generalize from sparse records and use distributed representations in huge-scale datasets. The maximum commonly used DNN architectures for sentiment evaluation in social media are recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). RNNs are especially nicely applicable to this project due to the fact that they are able to capture temporal and contextual data and capture the dynamics of language use. RNNs are also extra sturdy to noisy or unstructured entry, which is commonplace in social media information. Alternatively, CNNs are nicely suited to seize neighborhood patterns in textual content, consequently permitting them to study neighborhoods, which means from phrases or phrases. In order to observe DNNs to sentiment analysis in social media, these networks ought to be taught with relevant and correct labels. It requires the development of an excessively satisfactory categorized dataset for training and validation purposes, which can be quite exertion-intensive. Additionally, DNNs are required to enter statistics in a form that is suitable for education and can frequently be non-trivial to extract from social media resources.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Integration and AI-Driven Support: A Comprehensive Student Platform for Emotion Detection, Psychological Assessment, and Career Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This research paper introduces a meticulously crafted mental health and well-being platform tailored specifically to address the unique needs of 11th and 12th-grade students during critical academic junctures. Leveraging advanced machine learning techniques, the application employs emotion detection for insightful mood analysis, providing users with real-time insights into their emotional states to facilitate proactive mental health management. Integrating established assessment scales such as GAD7, SRQ20, and PHQ9 enhances diagnostic precision, enabling personalized stress relief activities. Seamlessly integrating psychiatric consultations through contact details, chat, and video calling capabilities ensures prompt professional support. An emotionally intelligent chatbot serves as a knowledgeable companion, offering guidance on mental health challenges and crucial academic and career decisions. Additionally, the application provides a vibrant community platform for users to engage, share insights, and access information on mental health and career guidance. In essence, this application bridges the gap between mental health support and academic pursuits, empowering students to navigate their educational journey while prioritizing their mental well-being.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and its Road to Altering the World Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Humans have longed for computers to take over and make the monotonous and tedious tasks obsolete. Artificial Intelligence(AI) is just the right answers to this problem. There are not one but many sectors that are being manipulated by this ever- growing technology. It is safe to say that each day machines are getting better at understanding humans which is due to the evolution and innovation in this field. In this paper, we have uncovered various sectors in which artificial intelligence along with its various branches like Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning(ML) and Computer Vision have helped the world curate a better place by personalizing every daily use item. This has enhanced the way we live. However, there is a lot of data that is being used in order to bring these technologies to life. We have highlighted the constraints as well as the pleasures that this technology can bring us.

articleTitle: Music Recommendation based on Emotions recognized through Speech and Body Gestures
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Throughout history, music has consistently remained a widely enjoyed source of entertainment, and technology has swiftly acknowledged its popularity. The emergence of numerous music streaming platforms has provided users with a plethora of choices, emphasizing the need for a system that simplifies the organization and search management of music. A project utilizing human-computer interaction (HCI) techniques to suggest songs by analyzing the user’s emotions extracted from speech input can significantly enhance the application’s personalization. This approach aims to create a more tailored and emotionally resonant experience for the user, establishing a deeper connection between the music recommendations and the user’s emotional state. However, relying solely on emotions from speech may not be very effective as it is subject to variations across people of different genders, race and culture. Speech emotion recognition may also be ineffective for the speech-impaired people. Hence, the objective of this project is to build a music recommendation system capable of discerning emotions from both body gestures and speech, enabling more comprehensive and nuanced song recommendations. In order to make effective recommendations using minimal amount of samples, meta learning models are used in both gesture and speech emotion recognition. This data is in turn used by the recommendation module. We have used the GEMEP Audio-Video dataset for emotion recognition using speech and body gestures. These identified emotions are then correlated with suitable song moods, forming the basis for the generated recommendations. The Emotion module of the model obtained an accuracy of 78.63% for multi-modal emotion recognition. The recommendation module obtained an accuracy of 98.02%.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network-Based Assessment of Two 20Kw PV Solar Energy Generation Plants in Homogeneous Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Renewable energy initiatives are of paramount importance in the substantial transformation of conventional power generation. An opportunity presents itself to mitigate the escalating demand for electricity through the utilization of the plentiful and intense solar radiation. The global influence of industrialization has led to a significant reliance on solar energy as a renewable source to meet India's domestic energy needs. In the Indian state of Uttarakhand, the purpose of this article is to provide an objective evaluation of the many solar photovoltaic (PV) power facilities that are now in operation. Photovoltaic (PV) systems harness solar energy to provide clean electricity, free from pollution or noise. Photovoltaic (PV) systems are characterized by their simplicity, ease of installation, and infrequent occurrence of malfunctions. Regrettably, the amount of energy produced by photovoltaic (PV) systems is contingent upon weather conditions, geographical location, and the design of the system. Several parameters are examined to evaluate technically identical solar power plants. Photovoltaic module tilt angle, annual deterioration, negative temperature coefficient of power, and other factors are considered. The assessment also includes identifying the reasons for any deviation in performance.

Author Keywords: National Solar Energy Federation of India (NSEFI)
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)

articleTitle: Investigating Water Quality in Cropland Through Hyper Spectral Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This research pursuits to investigate the impact of water high-quality on soil in croplands through the usage of hyperspectral photograph analysis. Hyperspectral images are acquired by combining the spectral information of various bands of electromagnetic radiation. Through reading the bands, various functions can be decided, consisting of elevation, topography, land cowl, moisture content material, and crop increase index. The vegetation index, which makes use of the reflectance information of various wavelengths, is used to assess the water's high quality. With the aid of reading hyperspectral pictures, it's possible to perceive soil properties which can be related to water first rate. Furthermore, the examine adopts qualitative and quantitative evaluation to similarly explore the underlying factors that affect water satisfaction in cropland. The consequences of having a look will assist in determining which measures can be taken to enhance water exceptional within the cropland and decorate its productivity.

articleTitle: Advanced IoT-Driven Freight Management for Enhanced Cargo Security and Efficiency in Transit using Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Freight transportation efficiency and safety are of the utmost importance in today’s age of globalization and the ever-increasing mobility of products. This study investigates new ways to use Internet of Things (IoT) technology to improve the tracking and management of shipping containers. Freight containers equipped with Internet of Things sensors may report on their position, temperature, security, and cargo integrity in real-time. This priceless data allows for preventative action to be taken against theft, unlawful entry, cargo damage, and the maintenance of optimum environmental conditions. In addition, the system’s data analytics features provide logistics experts with the information they need to simplify processes, optimize route planning, and boost productivity. This study improves the safety and efficiency of international commerce, decreases losses, raises customer happiness, and ensures compliance with regulatory requirements by tackling key difficulties in contemporary logistics. The results will have far-reaching advantages for all sectors that rely on the shipping of products.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning for Detection and Prediction of Malaria: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Mosquitoes carries a parasitic infection that affects millions of peoples globally. The initial and meticulous prediction of outbursts, patient verdict, and treatment enhancement can all considerably diminish the consequences of malaria. Machine learning is a promising method to tackle this problem with its capability to unveil and understand complex patterns from broad and multifaceted dataset. Accuracy of drug dosage and disease management in healthcare industry has proven phenomenal accuracy with use of machine learning algorithm. The current analysis explores the application of machine learning for prediction of malaria cases. This paper showcase the inclusion of numerous data source, comprising environmental factors, medical history and epidemiologic information to demonstrate how machine learning influences this to abundance of data to enhance prediction accuracy. This study also enhances the major advancements in prior malaria detection that have been made feasible and practicable by machine learning driven symptomatic technologies such prompt analytical test and image analysis of blood taints. Concerns like model comprehensibility, data secrecy, and equitable distribution of healthcare assets are also concealed in this review study.

articleTitle: LTA (Learn to Analyze) - A Teacher-Centric Analytical Dashboard for Illustrating Students Academic Progress, Backed by Machine Learning for Informed Performance Enhancement Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Previous research has firmly established that a communication gap between teachers and students can have detrimental effects on the learning process and student behaviors. In our study, we aim to explore how the implementation of a teacher-centric analytical dashboard can serve as a vital tool in visualizing and addressing this gap [1].Our research underscores the critical role of monitoring each student’s academic progress by their teachers for the purpose of enhancing overall performance. This paper will delve into the significance of this practice and how an analytical dashboard tailored to the needs of educators can facilitate this process. Through this exploration, we will highlight the key features and advantages of a teacher-centric analytical dashboard in fostering effective communication and ultimately improving the learning experience for students.

articleTitle: Secure EHR Storage System using Solana Blockchain and IPFS
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Electronic Health Records (EHRs) are crucial for effective patient care and informed decision-making. Proving the authenticity of Electronic Health Records (EHRs) is important for ensuring the quality and reliability of patient care and health insurance services. However, conventional EHR storage systems face issues such as data breaches and privacy violations. To address these challenges, the proposed system presents an innovative solution that combines blockchain technology and the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS). Our solution leverages the decentralized and secure data management features of IPFS to improve the security and accessibility of sensitive health information. Moreover, our solution employs solana blockchain technology to ensure that EHRs are securely stored and accessible only to authorized parties, creating a transparent and tamperproof environment. By incorporating solana blockchain technology, our solution enables health insurance providers to validate the authenticity of EHRs without relying on time-consuming and error-prone methods that are vulnerable to manipulation. Thus, our solution enhances the trustworthiness and accountability of the health insurance system. In summary, the proposed system aims to transform EHR management, providing a secure, decentralized, and efficient ecosystem that protects patient privacy while enhancing the overall integrity and accessibility of Electronic Health Records.

articleTitle: Transforming Crop Diagnosis: The Role of Federated Learning CNN in Cauliflower Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This research study explored a novel way of diagnosing and categorizing cauliflower leaf diseases by integrating federated learning (FL) with convolutional neural networks. Five populations of clients (px_1 to px_5) are used to evaluate five genera of cauliflower leaf diseases involving locally distributed data. The approach that we adopted encompassed the utilization of federated averaging methods for the integration of local learnings from each client’s dataset with a universal global model; further, once this was achieved, successful training of CNN models on every individual client's dataset. Thus, we used this approach to guarantee that the model could generalise better and become more robust through the efficient transfer of findings from separate datasets into a larger context. This research result can be described numerically as staggering in effectiveness. The model is compelling enough to learn from different data sources, as consistent enhancements in customer performance indicators attest. The model’s performance has consistently been evaluated based on the macro averages, ranging from 91.83% in px_1 to 97.42% obtained using px_5. The weighted averages regarding class imbalance were similar to the macro averages, ranging between 91.88% in px_1 and 97.41% in px_5. These numbers demonstrate that the model worked well, regardless of how familiar a particular illness class is in the dataset. For instance, micro averages reflecting overall accuracy improved from 91.87% observed for px_1 to per cent marks ranging between and exceeding at roughly equal increments until reaching an outstanding result of % noted with px5—mirrored trends witnessed among macro-averaging.

articleTitle: Agricultural Disease Detection: A Federated CNN Framework for Strawberry Leaves
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This study looks at a novel way of applying federated learning and convolutional neural networks (CNN) to find diseases in strawberry leaves. The study puts the problem at four levels of seriousness and uses four different people. The main goal is to use a learning method called federated learning. This way, you can learn from different ways of displaying data without risking your privacy. Strawberry leaf disease has four levels of seriousness: mild (1-25%), moderate (26–50%), severe (51–75%), and critical (76– 100%). The study shows that the model works well for four customers. It has positive measures like accuracy, recall, and F1-score while focusing on support and precision. Importantly, the big and small averages for every customer show that the model works effectively at different levels of seriousness. For example, Client jm_1 had a big average score of 93.79 and small average scores as well, which are also around the same levels, like 93.74 and 93.75, where weight matters in these cases but it's not much different from each other here so they didn't really notice any significant kind of gap between all their measurements they took at those Also, Client jm_2 had an overall average of 91.95 when looking at all results together. It also had a weighted average of 91.84 and a detailed or close-up version that was 91.85 on more specific details in the study reports they have prepared over time for their use in dealing with customers online via digital marketing. Clients jm_3 and jm_4 had substantial average scores of 93.73 for each, small top-weighted averages at 91.46 together, as well as tiny under-weighted averages around the same amount—that is, their own individual rates.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Distribution of Heterogeneous Workloads in Cloud Data Center
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Cloud computing has become a popular technology for on-demand services for end consumers. Geo-distributed data centers conduct most cloud computing jobs and may use a lot of energy. In this paper geo-distributed cloud data center energy-efficient workflow scheduling approaches are discussed. Scheduling jobs to virtual machines to prevent overloading servers is a key scheduling goal. To address the scheduling issue, load balancing is necessary. Effective load balancing reduces response time and maximizes resource use. In this paper, a technique for energy-efficient workload assignment to cloud data centers is proposed. The heterogeneous workloads from Google dataset are classified using machine learning techniques for energy-efficient assignment to appropriate data centers. Various clustering algorithms produced equal clusters. In our proposed approach, 2 clusters segregated data properly. The performances of various load balancers in varying scenarios are also compared in this research.

articleTitle: Advancements in Plant Leaf Disease Detection: A Comprehensive Review of Latest Trends and Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In the face of increasing global challenges in agriculture, the accurate and timely detection of plant diseases has become imperative for ensuring food security and sustainable crop production. Different machine-learning approaches to detecting plant leaf diseases are reviewed in this paper. This study focuses on the evolution of methodologies, challenges encountered, and the current state-of-the-art in this field. Leveraging the power of machine learning for plant disease detection holds promise for early diagnosis and effective disease management. The review synthesizes research findings, highlights critical advancements, and identifies potential areas for future research to contribute to the ongoing efforts in precision agriculture and smart farming.

articleTitle: RM&S Evaluation for Celestial Object Mission Focusing on the Moon having a Lunar Station(s) for Space Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The Moon exosphere, characterized by its extreme thinness, and its significant lower gravity compared to Earth marks a distinct advantage in terms of cost savings and energy efficiency for launching spacecraft from lunar surfaces to other celestial destinations. This study endeavors to explore and evaluate the essential aspects of Reliability, Maintainability, and Supportability (RM&S) for using the Moon as a lunar colonization, the establishment of lunar stations, space exploration missions, and the long-term human habitation on the Moon. In the initial phase of this research project, the author develops a Concept of Operation (ConOps) diagram that reflects an innovative perspective. The primary focus is to ensure that the reliability and managing the associated risk factors concerning with: the supply of critical resources such as food, water, and oxygen to support astronauts based on the Moon. In this research project, the Concept of Operation (ConOps) is developed and based mission plans; reliability and risk priority measure were evaluated. The main focus is on food, water, and oxygen supply for astronauts on the Moon. The possible complex systems were drawn to draw reliability structure and tabulated relative risk analysis for food/water/oxygen. The maintenance concept with LORA evaluation were evaluated for lunar nuclear plant and solar power station. The supportability measure is to evaluate probability of success that based on the author’s thoughts: one spare per system may not be enough to have a successful mission and therefore, there shall be at least two redundancies per system per operation for the least success rate of 92%. At the end, the minimum cost for a company on Earth was evaluated to prepare food/oxygen/water for astronauts on the Moon’s lunar station.(Note: All figures, images, tables, and intellectual contributions in this project are the original work of the author.)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Brain Metastasis Origin and Patient Mortality Predictions Using MRI with Clinical and Imaging Feature Information by Deep Learning Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Cancer is one of the worst prevailing diseases that affects millions of lives each year. Cancers is the uncontrolled growth of a type of cells which when travel to other parts of the body cause metastatic cancers. This paper focuses on brain metastasis. This paper uses machine learning and deep learning algorithms to predict the origin of the metastasis and predict the mortality in brain cancers. The study uses MRI with clinical and imaging feature information which also contains lifestyle factors like smoking along with medical attributes like edema. To predict the origin of the metastasis, LightGBM performed the best out of the boosting algorithms and predicted with an accuracy of 97.12%. Furthermore, 11 machine learning and deep learning algorithms were implemented to compare and find the optimum algorithm for mortality prediction in brain metastasis patients. Recurrent Neural Network predicted mortality with an accuracy of 99.50% among all the algorithms. Feature importance scores are also extracted for the best performing machine learning algorithm, XGBoost and it shows that edema volume has the highest importance in mortality, with smoking being the third most influential factor.

articleTitle: Sports Game Classification and Detection Using ResNet50 Model Through Machine Learning Techniques Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The intention of artificial intelligence (AI) sports analysis is to use AI and machine learning to get useful insights and enhance sports performance. Data from sporting events, players, and welfare equipment are processed and analysed using AI methods. Machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and other forms of artificial intelligence analysis are used to improve every facet of sports, from player efficiency to audience participation. It's a fast-paced, ever-changing industry that's revolutionising the way athletes, coaches, and fans interact with the sporting world. The ResNet-50 model and other machine learning techniques are at the bleeding edge of research into sports analysis and performance enhancement. The deep learning model ResNet-50 is used to analyse video and stills from sporting events. Application areas include player monitoring, injury prediction, and game result predicting, all of which are made possible by the use of transfer learning to collect subtle details in sports data. This approach ushers in a new age of data-driven decision making in the sports industry while also revolutionising sports analytics, providing access to invaluable information for coaches, players, and spectators. The primary objective of this research was to categorise nine distinct sports-related picture classifications and predict their expected accuracy, which came in at 93 percent. Future researchers in this field of study will benefit from the high level of accuracy shown in this work.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Configurable Logic Block (CLB) for FPGA using Various Circuit Topologies
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) represent a category of integrated circuits and also semiconductor devices like these offer a wide range of functionalities. They are aptly named as “field programmable” because they can be configured and reprogrammed after manufacturing also. This adaptability, flexibility and configurability have bought a significant transformation in digital circuits. One of the central features of FPGA is Configurable Logic Block (CLBs), which resembles a matrix interconnected through programmable links. Another crucial component is the SRAM, which can be reprogrammed to accommodate design changes or new implementations. Our primary focus lies on CLBs, where we delve into the impact of different multiplexer topologies within Look Up Table (LUTs). Our objective is to pinpoint the most efficient circuit topology that strikes a balance between power consumption and minimal delay. This investigation covers both the intricate details of circuit-level analysis and the broader implications for FPGA performance. The proposed design strategies and implantation is done in Synopsys tool using 32 nanometer technology. There has been a reduction in both power and delay.

articleTitle: ANFIS based Voltage Source Converter for Energy Management of Hybrid Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: To provide more reliable, stable and quality power to the load the integration of solar-wind and battery energy sources are required. Nevertheless, the energy management between these different nature power sources is challenging. Multiple power converters are additionally required to develop this hybrid microgrid. The overall performance of the hybrid energy system is much depends on the efficient controlling of these power converters. In this paper an advanced ANFIS controller is utilized to operate the single phase VSC converter at load side. To reach the load demand and enhance the power quality battery supported is considered to the solar and wind power generation. Extract more power from the solar P&O algorithm is employed.The performance of the proposed ANFIS based hybrid microgrid is investigated on two scenarios such as steady load connected to the variable solar-wind power generation and performance of the system when dynamic load is connected at constant PV and wind power generations. Form the obtained simulation results on these both these cases; the proposed ANFIS control strategy better energy management between solar-wind and battery energy sources.

articleTitle: Single layer Tri-Band Antenna for IRNSS Application using Symmetric Log Periodic Antenna with rectangular Co-axial Feed
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The proposed antenna operates in three bands with a single layer patch and is based on a symmetric circular log periodic antenna design that uses a coaxial feed with a shape of a rectangle whose size is the same as the central connection of the antenna. It resonates at 3 frequencies that correspond to the Indian Regional Navigational Satellite System (IRNSS) application. The frequencies are 1176.45Mega Hertz (L5 Band) , 1575.42Mega Hertz (L1 Band) and 2492.08Mega Hertz (S-Band). To make the stream more flexible, we can change one dimension at a time using the rectangular coaxial cable. Using the idea of circular symmetric log periodic antenna with rectangular coaxial cable, we were able to implement the Tri-Band antenna in a single layer patch.

articleTitle: Providing Security in Genesis and Other Blocks of Blockchain Technology Using SHA256 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The term Blockchain is familiar to everyone in the world, it is an immutable, decentralized with peer to peer network and distributed hyper ledger system. So no one can tamper or hacking this transactions easily. In the world various types of blockchain methods are used that are private bockchain public blockchain and hybrid blockchain. Now these methods are implemented in all organizations for security reasons, e.g. Crypto currency, logistic, education and economic etc. The blockchain allows all types of transactions and data to be more secure. Decentralized hyper digital ledger is used to securely record transactions on the blockchain network using a hash function that should be consistency. These data transactions are completed with a consensus algorithm called Proof of Work (PoW) and Proof of Stake (POS) with the help of hash function related algorithm SHA256. In this paper, we are going to explain how to provide security in genesis node, subsequent nodes and Markel tree construction of blockchain using SHA-256 algorithm, cryptography and hash functions and implementation of security in all level of Blockchain using SHA-256.

articleTitle: Suggesting Playlist and Playing Preferred Music Based on Emotion from Facial Expression
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Facial expression is a powerful indicator of human emotion and plays a crucial role in interpersonal communication. The mood of a person or his intention can be analyzed by detecting his expression. For detecting the expression, artificial intelligence and machine learning are very useful for automated detection. By analyzing facial features and expressions, a music recommendation system can predict the user's mood and recommend songs that align with their emotional state. Many researchers have worked on this.Our proposed system works on 8 moods of humans which are angry, contempt, disgust, fear, happy, neutral, sad, and surprise. This study utilizes a machine learning concept to achieve this goal. The methodology involves data collection, model training using a combination of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and VGG16 CNN, and recommending songs from the Spotify music dataset. The results show that both CNN and VGG16 CNN performed well in detecting facial expressions, with CNN achieving 66% accuracy and VGG16 achieving 92% accuracy. This system effectively recommends songs from the Spotify dataset based on the user's mood.

articleTitle: Auto Hyperparameter Tuning Approach for Connection of Industrial IOT 4.0 Devices Using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Classification Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Improving how well a machine learning model works is very much based on adjusting the hyperparameters. LSTM networks are used a lot in predicting sequences and analyzing time series. They are a type of recurrent neural networks. This work shows a way to make the process of finding the best settings for a computer model more automatic. It pays close attention to LSTM models. We will find the most important settings for our model, like how fast it learns, how many data points it looks at once, and other important numbers. Then we will decide the range of values to look at for each of these settings. This article talks about Industry 4. 0 and how it is being used with the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) 4. 0This is changing how companies monitor and maintain their systems. The Heat Index is important because it tells us how hot it feels outside when we combine the temperature and humidity. It is used in farming, predicting the weather, checking the soil, keeping machines working, and running data centers. It is important to use smart and flexible ways to look at Heat Index data so we can find patterns and useful information that will help us make good decisions. This study says we should use advanced methods to analyze data in the context of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) 4. 0It focuses on the importance of Heat Index data and how flexible it is. It shows how we can use this information to make things better in different industries. This study shows that using automated hyperparameter tweaking for LSTM models works well.

articleTitle: Filtenna Design for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: We introduce a novel filtering antenna, referred to as the "Filtenna," with compact dimensions of 125x100x1.67 mm. The filtenna is designed on an FR-4 substrate with a permittivity of 4.3 and is optimized to operate at both 2.28 and 2.7GHz frequencies. This innovative design combines the characteristics of a lower-band pass and higher-band pass filter within its design, effectively integrating the antenna and the band-pass filters. This integrated structure enables the separation of high-frequency and low-frequency components, leading to substantial miniaturization. The simulated results closely align with the measured data, validating the effectiveness of the filtenna in practice.

articleTitle: URL Shield: Protecting Users from Phishing Attacks using Flask and ML
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Cybersecurity threats, especially phishing attacks, continue to pose a significant risk to internet users. In response to this growing menace, we present "PhishShield," a robust and scalable solution that leverages machine learning within the Flask framework to detect phishing URLs effectively. Phish Shield incorporates a comprehensive set of features, including IP address analysis, URL characteristics, and domain-related attributes, which serve as the foundation for our machine learning models. Specifically, we employ Bernoulli naive bayes (Bernoulli NB) and Multinomial naive bayes (Multinomial NB) algorithms to classify URLs into three categories: Phishing, Legitimate, or Suspicious. Our system follows a systematic approach: it first collects and preprocesses datasets, and subsequently trains and tests the machine learning models. Upon successful training, PhishShield generates a pickle file, which can be used to determine whether a URL is susceptible to a phishing attack. The Flask-based web interface offers a user-friendly platform for users to input URLs and obtain instant assessments. Phish Shield’s utilization of static CSS and Bootstrap for web design ensures an intuitive and visually appealing user experience. The templates "base," "check," "home," "index," and "result" enhance the usability and interactivity of the system. PhishShield, we aim to empower users to navigate the web securely, providing a critical defense against phishing attacks. Our project not only showcases the capabilities of Flask and machine learning but also contributes to the ongoing battle against cyber threats.

articleTitle: Enhancing Recommender Systems with Hidden User Interests and Machine Learning : A Study of Multi -Label Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This research project, represents a significant endeavor in the field of recommender systems. It addresses critical challenges such as the "cold start" problem and the quest for superior recommendation quality. The core objectives encompass optimizing multi-label classifiers to maximize accuracy and efficiency, harnessing latent user interests for heightened personalization, particularly for users with limited explicit data, and expanding data sources for the creation of an all-encompassing user preference model. By uncovering latent user interests, the project aims to usher in a future where recommender systems provide users with recommendations that are not only highly accurate and deeply personalized but also adapt seamlessly to their evolving preferences, thereby elevating the overall quality of their online interactions. The overarching mission is to propel recommender systems into a new era of precision, where users across diverse domains can enjoy recommendations that are not only highly accurate but also deeply personalized, thereby enriching their online experiences.

articleTitle: Application of Dynamic Path Recommendation Algorithm in Urban Intelligent Transportation Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The role of transportation technology in urban traffic management is significant, but there is a problem with low planning accuracy. The static planning method cannot solve the problem of urban traffic management in urban construction, and there are fewer urban traffic management indicators. In today's era of rapid development of Informa ionization and intelligence, intelligent recommendation algorithm moistens every corner of the transportation industry like a clear spring. With its unique data insight and accurate matching ability, it is gradually reshaping our travel mode, relieving traffic pressure, improving urban operation efficiency, and even improving our expectations for future traffic.

articleTitle: Intelligent Virtual Worlds: A Survey of the Role of AI in the Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The metaverse has developed into an intriguing and dynamic environment that has the potential to alter how people communicate with computers and each other fundamentally. Due to its enormous potential for constructing immersive and intelligent virtual worlds, the metaverse has inspired strong interest and investment from a wide range of businesses, including gaming, entertainment, education, and social networking. The importance of artificial intelligence (AI) as a potent tool for developing intelligent and responsive virtual environments is central to this conception of the metaverse. This survey paper examines the most recent advancements in AI technology and their uses and roles. It provides a thorough review of the present status of AI in the metaverse. We emphasize the potential for AI to completely change how we engage with virtual worlds and one another by identifying significant trends and future directions for research and development in this field.

articleTitle: Applications of Machine Learning to Address Complex Problems in Livestock
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Machine Learning and Deep Learning-based applications have a vast potential to monitor livestock. Precise Livestock Farming (PLF) is essential to the smooth functioning of a farm to make it profitable in all aspects. PLF derives through feed monitoring, reproductively cycling, health, farm shelter, etc. It helps to maintain overall productivity and recognize health issues like foot-and-mouth disease, lameness, stress level, respiration rate, heart rates, lumpy skin disease etc., and bio-waste management. Assessment helps plan timely medication, vaccination, precaution and treatment for viral diseases. PLF also provides a solution for better health through emotional checkups to avoid loss from livestock. Precise Livestock Farming (PLF) can be practical when associated activities are effectively implemented and categorized in SLF and DLF.

articleTitle: Alzheimer Detection based on Optimized Machine Learning for EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a prevalent nervous system illness among the elderly population, and its likelihood of developing rises with age. One potential non-invasive measurement method that is frequently used to gauge changes in brain impulses is the electroencephalogram. To differentiate Alzheimer's patients, EEG waves are analyzed. Several studies assessed the clinical significance of Alzheimer's disease. In particular, recently developed evaluation techniques based on machine learning bring the fact to light by extracting features from EEG signals. Optimizing the network parameters of machine learning models using optimization algorithms can also lead to enhanced performance. Consequently, this study effort presents an optimized machine learning model for deep belief network-based Alzheimer's disease identification.. Particle Swarm Optimization is included in the proposed work to optimize the deep belief network parameters. The results are compared with the traditional deep belief network and illustrate that the suggested method outperforms the traditional approach.

articleTitle: Double C-Slot Monopole Antenna with Defected Ground Structure for Multi-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper introduces a multi-band rectangular antenna designed for wireless communication applications, specifically targeting Global System for Mobile communication (GSM), Wireless Fidelity (WiFi), and Worldwide interoperability for Microwave access (WiMAX) frequency bands. The antenna is aimed to enhance key performance parameters including, bandwidth, gain, and radiation pattern both in E&H planes. The antenna design incorporates a rectangular radiating patch with strategically placed two C-shaped slots, enabling multi-band operation. A Defected Ground Structure (DGS) is integrated beneath the radiating patch to mitigate surface wave propagation and suppress undesirable harmonics, thereby improving overall efficiency of the proposed antenna. The configuration of the DGS is optimized for optimal performance in GSM, Wi-Fi, and WiMAX frequency bands. Its compact size, broad bandwidth, and improved radiation characteristics make it a viable option for integration into wireless communication devices operating within these frequency bands.

articleTitle: Walnut Leaf Disease Identification with Multi-Level CNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: By combining Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) approaches, this study presents a new way to forecast which diseases would strike walnut leaves. The first of the study's four stages is the careful gathering and preparation of data to create a varied and consistent dataset. The next step is to train the model and extract features using a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture with three max-pooling layers, one fully connected layer, and three convolutional layers. This architecture works in tandem with support vector machines (SVMs) to facilitate multi-class classification and extract complex patterns related to diseases. When optimizing and integrating models, keep in mind that combining CNN and SVM strengths can improve illness prediction accuracy. The model assessment and performance analysis concludes by evaluating the model's effectiveness in illness prediction using a variety of indicators and comparison studies.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of High Speed Multiplier Using Hybrid Adder Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Electronic devices are necessary in small spaces in order to provide fast speed and low power consumption. Arithmetic operations determine how quickly electronics operate. In many applications involving VLSI signal processing, multiplication is a necessary arithmetic operation. Thus, to create any kind of signal processing module, a high-speed multiplier is a prerequisite. Every individual has different needs and goals, which has led to the development of different multipliers according to the need of application. In this paper, a Hybrid multiplier is proposed and designed using hybrid adders which is a mixture of Brent Kung adder and Kogge Stone adder which results in less delay i.e. 4.062ns compared to other multipliers existed.

articleTitle: American Sign Language Real Time Detection Using TensorFlow and Keras in Python
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to enhance communication for individuals with hearing impairments. We propose a sign language detection program in Python that integrates image recognition techniques to synthesize American Sign Language (ASL). The program achieves accurate recognition by analysing and interpreting ASL gestures using a convolutional neural network. The detected gestures are mapped to textual representations and relayed to the display interface for seamless communication. Evaluation of a diverse data set demonstrates the system's robustness and effectiveness. The developed program, implemented in Python using OpenCV and TensorFlow, offers a scalable solution to improve accessibility and inclusivity for the hearing-impaired community.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Alzheimer's Diagnosis from Brain MRI Images Using CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a slowly progressing neurological condition that predominantly impacts cognitive skills, it is essential to diagnose the disease early and accurately in order to provide appropriate treatment and patient care. In the realm of medical image analysis, recent developments in deep learning techniques, in particular Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have demonstrated a great deal of promise. This research outlines an innovative strategy for the early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease that makes use of CNNs. This research makes use of a database of brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. This database contains images from people who have been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease as well as healthy individuals. This research demonstrates that CNNs have the potential to be an effective diagnostic tool for Alzheimer's disease when used in conjunction with MRI images. The application of techniques from deep learning in medical imaging holds the potential to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of Alzheimer's disease diagnosis, which would ultimately be to the advantage of persons who are at risk and would make it easier to begin early intervention and treatment.

articleTitle: Development of Neural Network based Models for Health Assessment of Human Heart
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This research work is focusing on the designing and comparison of classification models to assess the heart health of humans. Two different techniques are explored. The first one is a simple competitive neural network based on unsupervised learning, while the second is a supervised neural network based on SCG (Scaled Conjugate Gradient) algorithm. The primary objective of this research work is to compare the accuracy of these two developed models in assessment of health of human heart. All simulations have been conducted in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Language Detection for Transliterated Content
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In the contemporary digital era, the Internet functions as an unparalleled catalyst, dismantling geographical and linguistic barriers, particularly evident in texting.
