In this project, our focus shifts to using Logistic Regression (LR), another potent technique in machine learning, known for its proficiency in dealing with binary and multiclass classification problems and LR estimates probabilities using a logistic function, which is particularly effective for categorizing data into distinct groups. This project involves analyzing electroencephalogram (EEG) signals, the intricate reflections of the brain’s activities, influenced by various emotional states. To utilize LR, the initial steps mirror those in SVM-based approaches. We collect EEG data from subjects experiencing a range of emotions, induced through different stimuli such as images or audio clips. This data is inherently complex and multi-dimensional, necessitating thorough preprocessing to isolate pertinent features. Once the features are extracted, they are input into the LR model. This model is adept at handling binary classifications (e.g., happy vs. not happy) and can be extended to multiclass problems (e.g., distinguishing between happiness, sadness, and stress) using techniques like one-vs-rest (OvR) or multinomial logistic regression. The model learns to associate specific EEG patterns with particular emotional states, assigning probabilities to these classifications. The implications of this research are profound, especially in the realms of human-computer interaction and healthcare. In technology, it could lead to AI systems that better understand and respond to human emotions, enhancing user experience. In healthcare, it offers a novel approach to diagnosing and managing emotional disorders, providing insights into the brain's response to different emotional states. This project, therefore, is not only a step forward in machine learning applications but also a significant contribution to our understanding of the complex interplay between the brain and emotions.

articleTitle: Emotion Classification of subjects while watching video, using Recurrent Neural Network and Tensorflow
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In the fast-evolving realm of contemporary computing, the challenge of accurately classifying emotions based on physiological signals remains a central focal point. This research embarks on an exploration of the utilization of Re-current Neural Networks (RNN), a potent machine learning technique, for the interpretation of human emotions derived from electroencephalogram (EEG) data. The impetus driving this inquiry stems from the growing demand for non-invasive, real-time emotion recognition systems capable of enhancing human-computer interactions. The EEG data collected from participants who were exposed to emotion-evoking stimuli form the cornerstone of this study. The RNN model undergoes meticulous training and evaluation, leveraging feature extraction from EEG signals. The primary objective is to effectively distinguish between fundamental emotional states, including reactions to positive, negative, and neutral stimuli. Our research outcomes underscore a promising level of accuracy in emotion classification, thus emphasizing the potential of RNN within this specialized domain. Furthermore, these results pave the way for future research directions, such as the integration of multi-modal data and the adoption of more advanced machine learning models to further amplify performance. This study contributes significantly to the field by demonstrating the effectiveness of RNN in EEG-based emotion classification, thereby laying the groundwork for the development of more intuitive and empathetic computing systems.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization for Optimal VM Allocation using Tuna Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Limitations of physical machines (PMs) and hence computation power are well known to humans today, due to which virtual machines (VMs) are used to enhance the computation capability and reduce the cost and space consumption for physical hardware. To leverage these VMs optimally, the placement of these VMs into PMs or clusters needs to be worked upon. Previously people have worked towards this allocation task using various approaches such as nature-inspired algorithms, decision-based algorithms, ML-driven algorithms, etc. Over the years, new algorithms are constantly being created which enhance the quality of the optimization task at hand. In this paper, we have compared Tuna Swarm Optimization with previously implemented techniques for multi-objective optimization in the placement of VMs.

articleTitle: Exploiting Fuzzy Logic for Time Series Classification in Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Fuzzy logic has come to be a crucial tool for processing and interpreting facts in diverse fields, which includes the evaluation and type of time collection information. This paper offers the application of fuzzy logic for time series category in networks. First off, the paper discusses the basics of fuzzy common sense, which include the ideas of fuzzy units and fuzzy common sense operations. It then introduces a fuzzy- based classifier for time series class, covering the layout of the membership capabilities, the calculation of rule strengths, and class of the time collection. Finally, an instance of a real-global time collection category the usage of fuzzy logic is provided, demonstrating the capability of this method for analyzing and classifying time series facts. The paper concludes with some observations and discusses the future ability of making use of fuzzy common sense to time collection class in networks.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Health Big Data based on Semi-Supervised Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The role of health big data in medical health is very important, but there is the problem of inaccurate data. Traditional methods cannot solve the problem of health big data in medical health, and the results are not satisfactory. Therefore, this paper proposes a semi-supervised learning algorithm for health big data analysis. With the rapid development of information technology, especially the combination of artificial intelligence and big data analysis technology, the medical and health field is undergoing a revolutionary change. Among them, semi-supervised learning, as a machine learning method that can effectively utilize a large amount of unlabeled data, provides a new solution for healthy big data analysis. The purpose of this paper is to discuss the research progress of semi-supervised learning algorithm in the application of health big data, and analyze its impact on future medical and health services.

articleTitle: Advanced Anomaly Detection For Fuel Cell Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Remote sensor and telemetry, nowadays represent an exceptional tool for monitoring and maintaining critical systems especially in aerospace engineering. Spacecrafts, rovers and other aerospace devices always depend on fuel cells. Health and reliability of the missions are very crucial. This paper offers an in-depth report on fuel cell health anomaly detection methods that are carried out on dataset taken from NASA. Our approach involves using several machine learning and statistical methods to derive the unexpected patterns out of the data. In essence our report shows that they are effective in achieving the desired goal, and can be used in a practical setting. The paper provides the development of fuel cell health monitoring for successful mission in space exploration and improves mission reliability. This paper presents interesting results that the aerospace industry and the general anomaly detection fields may find useful.

articleTitle: Integrated Blockchain Model for Personal Identifiable Information System (IBPIIS): A Secure Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: With the proliferation of information technology, the application of the Internet of Things (IoT) has gained momentum in various domains. This resource-constrained device is interfaced with many field devices to gather data, amounting to data for diverse applications. Securing this data either in a data store or in transition is an emerging area of research, that deals with the implementation of IoT Blockchain to maintain confidentiality and data integrity. This paper presents a network in which highly operational resources can be combined with blockchain to prevent data tampering. The proposed IBPIIS is a framework that integrates consensus method, authentication by hashing, smart contract, and distributed management scheme, with smart devices and blockchain ecosystem to ensure security and information management. A comprehensive simulation is run under several scenarios on the system developed to analyze its performance in terms of time complexity and energy efficiency. This analysis also presents an improved blockchain-based Personal Identifiable Secure Management System to develop a data storage model that can efficiently handle the drawbacks of data redundancy and limited data storage space.

articleTitle: Providing Security for a Chat Application using RSA Encryption with GPG
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The aim of this project is to implement a program to secure a chat application by means of the Rivest–Shamir–Adleman algorithm, using the Python module for the Gnu Privacy Guard. RSA-1024 was used for encryption of the chat application, which follows a client-server architecture system.

articleTitle: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) feature in Modern Autonomous Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: The process of creating, promoting, and advancing technology is known as technological transformation. With integrated vision, advanced driver assistant system (ADAS) are actively focusing on collision avoidance technologies and driver aids, such as night vision, driver alertness and adaptive cruise control, car safety in the modern environment. Automobile manufacturers invest millions of dollars each year to support the creation of innovative technology that keeps drivers secure and accident-free while operating their cars. Each of these technologies together referred to as "advanced driver assistance systems" in the market, is managed by intricate real-time embedded systems. This article focuses on the creation of a vehicle prototype for collision avoidance system, a blind spot detection system, and a vehicle tracking system. It provides in-depth summaries of each version's past, current, and future designs. This research results insures driver’s safety, vehicle location tracking etc. Here in this research article we added 3-4 features but in actual vehicle we could expand up to all features depending upon customer’s requirements. Additionally we could control by using CAN control as well.

articleTitle: Ensemble Approaches for Offensive Language Detection in Kannada
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: In the realm of natural language processing, sentiment analysis remains a focal point due to its pivotal role in discerning and analyzing public sentiments. While past research has been dedicated to enhancing the performance of sentiment analysis models, this study delves into the potential benefits of ensemble techniques, with a special emphasis on Genetic Algorithm (GA) optimization, The main thrust of this research was to investigate whether merging multiple models and subsequently optimizing their weights via GA could elevate performance. Evaluations were thoughtfully conducted, focusing on the weighted precision, recall, and F1-scores of individual models. Additionally, the study compared the ensemble methods, both with and without GA optimization, The ensemble method, even without the GA optimization, secured an impressive F1-score of 0.73. Upon integrating the GA optimization, there was a gentle improvement in the ensemble’s performance, achieving an F1-score of 0.75, In summing up, this study manifests a palpable enhancement in sentiment analysis outcomes when shifting from standalone models to a GA-optimized ensemble mechanism. The results, epitomized by an F1-score peaking at 0.75, underline the intrinsic merits of harnessing GA for weight optimization in ensemble constructs.

articleTitle: Implementation of Supervisory Level in Industrial Automation Pyramid
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Within the intricate landscape of industrial demand response, the fundamental concept of supervisory control takes precedence. This research delves into the diverse array of energy flexibility strategies deployed within industrial contexts, intricately intertwined with foundational production IT systems, resulting in a dynamic reconfiguration of the hierarchical automation framework. This in-depth study offers a more comprehensive outlook, considering not only the internal IT systems but also those critical to empowering enterprises to enhance their energy adaptability by establishing connections with energy markets and aggregators. The tangible outcome of this investigation equips businesses with the tools and insights necessary to fine-tune and capitalize on their energy flexibility. Crucially, this all-encompassing approach culminates in a systematic classification of industrial demand response functionalities, serving as a vital reference for implementing supervisory control within the industrial automation paradigm. Notably, it extends its scope to encompass both field and control levels through the integration of sophisticated hardware applications. However, at the heart of this research lies the pivotal role of supervisory control, facilitated by the Siemens S7-1200 PLC HMI schematic, uniting field, control, and supervisory levels in a cohesive framework.

articleTitle: Synthetic Generation of Spatial Polygons On Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Spatial Data generated from varied resources are collected for applications in analysis of land-patterns and population growth among many. While the data collected is vast, majority of it is unavailable in formats or quantity required for research projects. Current data generation tools produce overly rigid geometric objects which do not reflect real-world spatial variations of polygons. We present a web based synthetic generator tool for spatial polygons capable of generating an impressive 0.7 million polygons which would take a range of user inputs including spikiness, irregularity and dataset size to generate requirement quenching data. Generated polygons are thus subject to rigorous benchmarking to ensure that they are close to real-world in addition to being geometrically valid. We further explore the computational problems and propose a spark-based approach of parallel computation, resulting in a remarkable 50% reduction in processing time.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Recognition English Translation Model based on Kmeans Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, intelligent English translation methods have emerged as the times require, and become an important bridge for cross-language communication. This paper will discuss the principles, advantages and challenges of intelligent English translation in depth, and explain how to use intelligent translation tools efficiently to improve the accuracy and fluency of language conversion through concrete examples. The role of model design in intelligent recognition of English translation is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate translation. The previous orthographic translation method could not completely solve the model design problem of intelligent recognition of English translation, and the translation was unreasonable. In the tide of globalization, English, as the main language of international communication, is of great importance. However, for non-native English speakers, language differences often become barriers to communication.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antenna for Wi-fi Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This project focuses on designing a microstrip patch antenna for optimal performance in 2.4 GHz WiFi applications. Using advanced tools like CST Studio Suite, the goal is achieving resonance, enhancing characteristics like gain and radiation pattern. Anticipated outcomes include a finely tuned antenna meeting advanced WiFi communication needs, with broader implications for routers, access points, and IoT devices. The project’s significance extends to shaping the landscape of wireless communication systems in our interconnected future.

articleTitle: Research on Network Intrusion Detection Based on Cluster Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, there are many different forms of network attacks, and how to accurately identify network intrusion attacks has become the core of cyberspace security. There are many noise and redundancy terms in real-time network data, and the original intrusion detection technology has low accuracy and poor feature extraction ability. Therefore, this paper studies the network intrusion detection problem based on the cluster learning algorithm, establishes a network intrusion detection system based on the cluster learning algorithm, and uses the relevant feature selection to select the corresponding subset evaluation method to complete the feature selection, which can reduce the feature dimension, reduce data redundancy, significantly improve resource utilization, and reduce time complexity. After applying this algorithm, it can effectively improve the detection accuracy and detection rate of the system, which is an important way for network security detection.

articleTitle: Accounting Resource Sharing Management Risk Assessment Model of Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Accounting information is a very important part of accounting resource sharing, accounting resource sharing can greatly save manpower and material resources, among which risk assessment is very important, you can know whether accounting information resources are safe. Traditional assessment methods cannot better meet the needs of today's society. Therefore, this paper proposes an artificial intelligence algorithm for risk assessment and analysis. First, the computer is used to classify and analyze the accounting information, and the indicators are divided according to the risk assessment requirements to reduce the risk assessment in the interfering factor. Then, the computer shares the results of the risk assessment with the accounting resources, forms a risk assessment plan, and conducts the risk assessment results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy of risk assessment of artificial intelligence algorithms for accounting resource sharing Risk assessment authenticity is superior to traditional assessment methods.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of a Real-Time Semantic Segmentation System for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: Autonomous driving represents a revolutionary technology poised to reshape the automotive industry, offering the promise of safer, more efficient, and environment friendly vehicles. Real-time semantic segmentation is considered as a fundamental component of autonomous driving systems, playing a pivotal role in scene comprehension and decision-making. In this paper, an attempt is made to design, analyze and evaluate real-time semantic segmentation algorithms for autonomous driving. The proposed algorithms and architectures are initially tested on a laptop with GPU and later implemented on two distinct embedded platforms: Raspberry Pi 4 (8GB RAM) board and Xilinx Zynq 7000 FPGA-based PYNQ (Python Productivity for Zynq) Z2 development board. The performance evaluation of proposed real-time semantic segmentation system using various hardware and architectures are reported in this paper. The maximum Mean Intersection of Union (mIoU) obtained from proposed system is 0.8315 and the best refresh rate achieved is 18.32. The proposed system had few limitations on the PYNQ board, whereas the Raspberry PI board gave satisfactory results. The proposed work can be easily extended to other hardware and offers insights that can be leveraged to optimize autonomous driving systems for edge devices.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of CMOS SRAM 6T, 7T and 9T Cells using Cadence at 180nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference for Innovation in Technology (INOCON)
abstract: This study deals with the exploration and analysis of CMOS SRAM cells utilizing 180nm technology nodes, conducted through implementation and simulation in the Cadence tool. The focus centers on three distinct SRAM cell architectures: the conventional 6-transistor (6T) cell, an enhanced 7-transistor (7T) variant, and an expanded 9-transistor (9T) configuration. The primary aim is to assess and compare their performance based on critical metrics such as power consumption, Signal to Noise Margin Ratio (SNR), Read Delay, and Write Delay. The design methodology involves designing of each S-RAM cell type, followed by Cadence Virtuoso simulations to evaluate their functionality under diverse operating conditions. The analysis further enables into the performance characteristics of each cell. Simulation results highlight inherent trade-offs in each S-RAM cell design. The simplicity of the 6T cell serves as a baseline, while the 7T and 9T cells demonstrate enhanced stability and reduced susceptibility to read and write disturbances. Significantly, a 39.29% and 22.62 % reduction in power usage for 7T and 9T S-RAM cells, respectively, contrast to the S-RAM 6T cell, emphasizes the potential for selecting an appropriate S-RAM architecture based on specific application requirements, balancing performance, area efficiency, and reliability.

Author Keywords: Signal to Noise Margin Ratio (SNR) and Power Consumption
